column3: `awol_post_missed_training_news(player, club)`: posts the 0xbc9 missed training news. Called by the missed training (`miss_training`). SEH frame for the local news, no destructor. \n With a player who has a player sheet (`.player()`) and a club with a manager (`club::MANAGER`): the news 0xbc9 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the player (id and the `names::ID` keys of `first_name()`, `second_name()`, `common_name()`), the club id, draw(3), whether the club is human-run (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 0, 1) and who reports it: the manager, if the club has a manager and is not human-run (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1; id and keys); otherwise, with draw(2), one of the 5 coaches (`club::COACHES`, draw(5) until one is found or a thousand tries), and without the draw the assistant (`club::ASSISTANT_MANAGER`); with nobody (or id −1), −1 in all four. \n Human-run club (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`): sent to the player's club (`club_job()`, `exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); otherwise, if the club has a nation (`club::NATION`) and the player's reputation (`.player().current_reputation()`) is above 7250, to the nation's inboxes (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`).

`AWOL::daily_update()`: resolves the day's AWOL cases, missed trainings and late arrivals. Called every day by the game loop (0x5cccd0). Three lists, each with its cursor at `llist::CURSOR`. 
 (1) Absences ([this]): the first one whose return date (+4) has passed ends (`exe::awol_end_absence`). 
 (2) Missed trainings ([this+4]): the first one a week past its date (+4) is resolved (`resolve_awol_case`). Repeat case (`awol_missed_training::REPEAT_CASE`), with two draws coming out zero, by the person's professionalism (`staff::PROFESSIONALISM`) and temperament (`staff::TEMPERAMENT`): both drop by a draw and the person misses training again (`awol_miss_training`). New case: the teammates at the club (50 slots, `club.squad()`) under the offender's contract may ask to leave (`exe::staff_contract_set_flags` with 2) or lose professionalism, work rate (`.work_rate()` of the player) and temperament; and the offender, when draw(professionalism) is below draw(15) + 1, loses professionalism and work rate (`player_sheet::WORK_RATE`), misses training again and falls out with the club (`exe::media_create_player_media_story` with 8). 
 (3) Late arrivals ([this+8]): the first one a week past (+8) that wins the draws (repeat case by `awol_fitness_incident::REPEAT_CASE`) loses professionalism and temperament or work rate (`player_sheet::WORK_RATE`). 
 Each resolved case leaves its list (`exe::llist_remove`) and bit 2 of the flag (`person_flags::MISSED_TRAINING`) flips. A list that ends before the count ends the day.

`AWOL::has_missed_training(person)`: returns bit 2 of the person's flag (`person_flags::MISSED_TRAINING`); without a contract, clears the miss first. Called by the daily player update (0x5a69b0) and by the screens. \n Null person or beyond the count (`G_STAFF_COUNT`): false. With bit 2 of her flag (`awol_fields::PERSON_FLAGS` + id) set and no contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, stored in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`), clears the miss (`exe::awol_clear_missed_training`) first. Returns bit 2 of the flag.

`AWOL::has_fitness_incident(person)`: true when the person has a record in the late arrival list. Called by the daily player update (0x5a69b0). \n Null person, beyond the count (`G_STAFF_COUNT`) or no late arrival list ([this+8]): false; otherwise walks the list (cursor at `llist::CURSOR`) looking for the person's record (id at +0). True in the low byte; the high bytes as the original leaves them in the register.

`AWOL::miss_training(person)`: the player misses training (or, if very unhappy, may go AWOL). Called by the day's missed trainings (`game_check_players_missing_training`) and by awol_daily_update. SEH frame only for the local date, no destructor. \n Player (`.player()`) within the count, with a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) at a club and without flag 2 (`person_flags::MISSED_TRAINING`): if the contract has morale (`contract::MORALE`) at or below −100 and bit 0x2000 (then 0x800) in `contract::GRIEVANCES`, and draw(professionalism + 10) and draw(`.loyalty()` + 10) both come out zero, he goes AWOL (`exe::awol_start_absence` with 0, 0). \n Otherwise: sets bit 2, posts the missed training news (`exe::awol_post_missed_training_news`, with the contract's club), byte +0xa of the 79-byte row (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`, `staff_state::SIZE`) adds draw(10), the condition (`exe::injury_get_condition`) drops by 25 × (21 − the player's `.natural_fitness()`) + draw + 100 (`exe::injury_set_match_condition`), and the record (person, today, case) joins the missed training list ([this+4], `exe::llist_add_tail`); the case byte, unset in the original, goes 0x90 (`AWOL_RESIDUE_BYTE`). AI club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) with a manager (`club.manager()`, `.non_player()`) and draw(his `.discipline()`) not zero: the fine (`exe::fine_fine_player`, period 1 if draw(manager rating `exe::non_player_attribute_rating` with `.man_handling()`) beats draw(5), else 2; reason 1).

`AWOL::end_absence(record)`: ends an absence. Called by awol_daily_update. \n With the person's flag (+0 id; `awol_fields::PERSON_FLAGS` + id) not zero: if she has a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) at a club, the return news (`exe::awol_post_news` with the person's club `club_job()`, 0 and −1); flips bit 1 of the flag (`person_flags::ABSENT_WITHOUT_LEAVE`; the original's `or 1` never gives zero) and removes the record from the absence list ([this], `exe::llist_remove`). Does not read an unset local.

`AWOL::report_poor_fitness(player, club)`: records a fitness incident and handles the reaction. Called by the daily person update (0x5ce2d0: the day's big drop in condition). SEH frame for the date and the local news, no destructor. 
 The record (player, club, today and a byte that in the original is stack leftover) joins the incident list ([this+8], `exe::llist_add_tail`, 0x11 bytes). 
 Human-run club (`club_has_human_manager`): one coach from the 5 slots (`club::COACHES`, draw(5), until one is found or draw(20) comes out zero) and the news 0x138f to the club (the player, draw(2), his keys and the coach's, or −1). 
 AI club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) with a manager (`club::MANAGER`, `.non_player()`): draw(his `.discipline()`) above draw(10) leads to the fine (`exe::fine_fine_player`, period 1 if draw(rating `exe::non_player_attribute_rating` with `non_player::MAN_HANDLING`) beats draw(5), else 2; reason 1).

`AWOL::is_player_awol(p, so_read)`: returns bit 0 of the person's flag (`person_flags::ABSENT_WITHOUT_LEAVE`); without `so_read` and without a contract or club, the absence ends first. Called by the squad selection, training, asking price, the staff day and transfers. \n Null person or id beyond `G_STAFF_COUNT`: 0 (only al). With `so_read`, bit 0 of the person's flag (`awol_fields::PERSON_FLAGS` + id). Otherwise, with the bit set and no contract (`injury_main_contract_stored`) or no club on the contract, the absence ends (`exe::awol_clear_awol`); returns the bit read again.

rule: 48 Italian clubs enter the Coppa Italia. The 32 of the group stage: the season's Serie B clubs, those that came from Serie B in 4th, 5th or from 18th down and those that came from C1 in 4th, 5th or 6th (positions counted from 0 [inference]); if short, C1 clubs by position (6th, 7th...). The 32 are sorted (`sort_pointers` with 0x640590) and split into 4 pots of 8, and each of the 8 rounds draws one club from each pot. In the 2nd round enter the top 3 of last season's Serie B (the promoted) and the Serie A clubs from 10th to 15th; last, the top 9 of Serie A, up to 48 (the rest are left out by table order)
rule: the Asian Cup Winners' Cup has 16 teams, the qualified clubs (`asia_club_champ_fields::QUALIFIED_CLUBS`) in the order they were picked, all with class and status 0

Builds the table of the first group of the Copa Libertadores. Rule: group 1 has 4 clubs, the first 4 drawn, each in the row of its order; human managers get the group draw news. \n Ret 0: 4 teams (`set_club_count`), table `set_table` (`exe::crt_malloc`(0xec): push 0xec; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 4 rows of 0x3b bytes; out of memory: the box at line 0x16f and returns 0), each row i with drawn club i (`conmebol_liber_drawn_club`) (`exe::league_init_table_row`: push 0; push 0; push club; push i; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10), the group draw news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news`: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0) and returns 1. The same body as `init_group_a_table` of the African Nations Cup (only the file and the box line change).

Creates a group stage of the Copa Libertadores. Rule: each of the other groups is a league stage with the next 4 drawn clubs (4g + 4 to 4g + 7), the cup's rules and year and the cup's round table for the group; human managers get the news. \n Ret 4; SEH frame only for the stage's `exe::crt_operator_new` (no destructor on the normal path): the stage of group g + 1 (g from 0 to 6, from the draw day). The teams in a vector of `club_count()` pointers (`exe::crt_malloc`(`club_count()` << 2): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory: the box at line 0x218 and 0): drawn clubs 4g + 4 to 4g + 7 (`conmebol_liber_drawn_club`); the round table through virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments: the cup, the teams (`club_count()`, word), the vector, `legs()` (word), `competition()`, the round table, the rounds (word), `win_points()`, `draw_points()`, `match_category()`, &`league::TIEBREAKS`, &`league::PROMOTED_COUNT`, the year `year()` (word), g, the id (word), `importance()`, 2, 0, `league_flags()` (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes clean values) in `stages()[g]`; the vector and the round table are freed (`exe::crt_free`). No stage: the box at line 0x22e and 0. With it: the group news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news` on the stage), `set_current_stage(g)` and 1.

Selects the clubs qualified for the Libertadores. Rule: takes the 32 clubs marked with it as the season's continental competition (the mark comes from league qualification), in database order, then shuffled (96 random swaps) for the groups; any other count is an error (the box). \n Ret 0: `ConmebolLiber::select_qualified_clubs()`: `conmebol_liber::DRAWN_CLUB_COUNT` = 32 and the list `conmebol_liber::DRAWN_CLUBS` (`exe::crt_malloc`(0x80): push 0x80; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory: the box at line 0x285 and returns 0) with the clubs, in database order, whose season competition (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID`, `libertadores_entrants`) is the Libertadores, up to 32; fewer than 32: the box at line 0x297 and returns 0; otherwise the list is shuffled (`exe::comp_util_shuffle_pointer_array`(list, 32): push n; push list; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; 3 × 32 random swaps) and returns 1.

rule: in the seven groups (stages 0 to 6), a club going through gets the qualification record (weight 40) and one going out the failed-to-qualify record (weight 40); in the knockout (stage 7), a club going through gets the qualification by round (weight 50 to 100), one going out the knocked-out record; the winner gets the title record and goes to the Intercontinental Cup, in the South American place (place 0 if a club of continent `KEY_CONTINENT_SOUTH_AMERICA` is there, otherwise place 1), with the Intercontinental season archive and predicted positions; the runner-up gets the runner-up record

rule: the Libertadores knockout has 16 clubs: the top 2 (`promoted_count()`) of each of the 8 groups (group 1 in table order, the others by position in each stage's table), in a cup stage (stage 7) with the cup's round table and year; the first round is drawn at once

`HostCountry::post_host_news(list)`: posts the news of changed hosts. Called by the hosts calendar `host_country_daily_update`; SEH frame only for the local news, no destructor. \n For each entry of the list (cursor reset, `llist::CURSOR`; `exe::llist_get_next`), except the chosen bid (`host_entry::CHOSEN_BID`, or the fixed default) of the edition 8 years ahead (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR` + 8), the Olympics (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_OLYMPIC_GAMES`) and the 2006 World Cup in Germany (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_FIFA_WORLD_CUP`, 0x7d6, `KEY_NATION_GERMANY`): with voting open (−1), news 4 (the bids: competition, year and the six nations); otherwise news 5 (the chosen bid: competition, year and its two hosts, the first one in the fixed default), built by `exe::new_newsitem`/`exe::newsitem_set_slot` and delivered to the managers of the competition's continent (table `G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE`, 0x6b bytes, `competition::CONTINENT`; `exe::news_send_to_continent_managers`) or to everyone (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`).

Sets the season expectations of each club in the table, through the manager manager, with the news. \n Ret 0, a league method: `League::set_club_season_expectations()`: with the manager manager (`G_MANAGER_MANAGER`), the season expectations of each club in the table (`table()`, rows of `league_table_row::SIZE` bytes, `club_count()` clubs) through `exe::manager_manager_set_season_expectations` (push 1; push club; mov ecx, `G_MANAGER_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 8: with the news).

Moves the club down to the division (keeping the previous one), applies the relegation clauses and makes the human manager leave when the division is not played. \n Ret 0xc; this is not read: `club.relegate_club_to_division(division, _)`: the club's competition (`club::DIVISION`) becomes the division and the previous one goes to `club::LAST_DIVISION`; the relegation clauses (`exe::contract_manager_trigger_relegation_clauses` push old; push club; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 8); if the division is not played (no competition table `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, no division or no competition with its id) and the club has a human manager who decides (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` push 0; push 0; push 1; push 1; push club; add esp, 0x14 -> cdecl), the manager leaves (`exe::manager_manager_remove_club_manager` push 0; push 7; push 1; push club; mov ecx, `G_MANAGER_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 0x10).

Moves fixtures for TV: on the TV table dates, each slot takes the highest-rated fixture (a random draw by reputation, zeroed when either club plays 2..5 days before or after; 100/50 in national team slots) to the weekday and time slot of the slot, with the news, the stadium and the calendar. \n Ret 4; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates and list): `date.move_fixtures_for_tv()`, from the league day (`league_update_for_date`) and from building the calendar (0x683e30). Through the date's entry (tv_date_entry), the league matches on the entry's day and time slot (+4) go to a local list (`exe::new_llist`; `exe::fixture_manager_collect_comp_fixtures_on_day`: push list; push league `stage_index()`; push -1; push id; push slot; push day; push year; mov ecx, `G_FIXTURE_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 0x1c). With matches: the entry's slots (7 bytes from +5, up to the first with `league_round_date::TV_SLOT_KIND` = 0xff) are sorted (`exe::crt_qsort` with 0x8b4e00) if any has bits 0x7fc0 in dword +5. For each slot with time slot (`league_round_date::TV_SLOT_TIME_SLICE`) 0..2: the date moved to the slot's weekday (`league_round_date::TV_SLOT_WEEKDAY`; `exe::date_get_nearest_weekday`); the clash window: 2..5 days after the requested date if the TV day falls after it, otherwise 5..2 days before (`exe::date_add_days`/`exe::date_sub_days` + `exe::date_operator_3d`). Among the matches in the list (of the league's type, `fixture::STAGE_INDEX`), the one with the highest rating (signed word; the first on a tie): slot of type 3, 100 for a national side match (`exe::database_is_national_team` on the home side) in the stadium (`fixture::STADIUM` → `city()` → `city::NATION`) of the nation of either side, otherwise 50; otherwise the random draw (`exe::utils_random`) of the away side's reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) + 1500 plus that of the home side's, zeroed if either has a match in the window (`FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_FIND_FIXTURES`). The chosen one: outside type 3, news 3 to both clubs; it leaves the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`), takes the TV date, the time slot and the slot's type, the stadium (`FN_STADIUM_SET_FIXTURE_VENUE`) and goes back into the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`); the slot becomes 0xff and the match leaves the list (`exe::llist_remove`).

Sends the group draw news 0x15 (the competition, the first date, the opponents) to each human-managed club in the group. \n Ret 0; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path: `League::send_group_draw_news()`, from the competitions' group draw. A group of up to 8 teams (`club_count()`; the `league_table_row::SIZE`-byte teams in `table()`, +0 the club): for each club with a human manager (`cup_has_human_manager`), news 0x15 (allocated once, `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xdf), built by `exe::new_newsitem`, freed at the end by `exe::crt_operator_delete` without a destructor) with the competition id, `stage_id()`, the first date (that of the first entry of table `round_dates()` moved to the weekday of each slot, `exe::date_get_nearest_weekday`, the earliest), the number of opponents; per club, its own id (2) and those of the others (6 onwards), delivered to it (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Sends news 0xd with the first three fixtures (date, opponent, venue) to each human-managed club not yet told, and does the same in the following stages. \n Ret 4; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local lists): `list.send_fixture_list_news()`, from creating the calendar (0x5cd1e0) and from the league day in its year. Uses the local list (`exe::new_llist`) if the league is a first stage (`stage_index()` = `stage_index::MAIN`) or there is no list. With the competition counting (`exe::comp_util_is_league_division`: push id; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and a first stage: the date of the first entry of table `round_dates()` minus 5 days (`exe::date_sub_days`, `exe::date_operator_3d`); for each club with a human manager (`cup_has_human_manager`; `league_table_row::SIZE`-byte teams in `table()`) that is not in the list (4-byte ids): its first 3 matches from that date (`FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_SCAN_FIXTURES` into a local list, 18 arguments: push 1; push -1; push `stage_index()`; push 0; push list; push 3; push -1 ×4; push club id; push -1; push -1; push competition id; push 1; push &slot; push &day; push &year; mov ecx, `G_FIXTURE_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 0x48); finding 3: news 0xd (competition id, club id, the league year and, per match, the day, the year, the opponent and 1 at home or 0 away) to the club, which enters the list (`exe::llist_add_tail`: push 4; push club; mov ecx, list -> thiscall, ret 8). Then, in the stages (`stages()`, up to `current_stage()`) with `league::COMP_TYPE` = 2, the same routine with the list (`exe::league_send_fixture_list_news`).

Creates the season fixtures: the round-robin grid (with the club order drawn) or the year's own list, home and away by the parity of the half and the year, the stadium, date and slot of each round, and the calendar; then the TV dates. \n Ret 0; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates): `League::create_fixtures()`, from building the competitions (44 calls up to 2002-06-01). With n = teams (`club_count()`) + teams % 2: `set_complete(0)`; the grid of n rows of n dwords (`exe::crt_operator_new`; out of memory: the box at line 0x3fc or 0x405 and 0), built by `exe::league_build_round_robin_grid` (push n; push grid -> stdcall, ret 8: it does not read the mov ecx, this before it) and, outside competitions `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FIFA_WORLD_CUP` and `KEY_CLUB_COMP_EUROPEAN_FOOTBALL_CHAMPIONSHIP`, the club order drawn (`exe::league_draw_team_order`: push n; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4). The match record (0x4f bytes on the stack): +0 competition id, `fixture::MATCH_STATS_SLOT` = -1, `fixture::COMPETITION` the competition, `fixture::NEXT_ROUND_YEAR`/`fixture::NEXT_ROUND_DAY` the last date of the table (`round_dates()`, entry `round_count()` − 1), `fixture::SEASON_YEAR` year (`year()`), `fixture::ROUND_NAME` = 0 (`round_name::NONE`), `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX` (`stage_id()`), `fixture::ROUND_DRAW_RULES` (`round_draw_rules()`), `fixture::TIE_RULES` (`match_rules()`), `fixture::CATEGORY` (`match_category()`), `fixture::STAGE` = 0xff, `fixture::HOME_RESULT_MARK`/`fixture::AWAY_RESULT_MARK` = 0, `fixture::STAGE_INDEX` stage (`stage_index()`), +0x43..+0x4c = 0xff, and the league's method `comp_vtable::SET_FIXTURE_SUBSTITUTES` with it. With its own list (`fixed_fixtures()`, 0x10-byte entries: +8/`fixed_fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID` the club ids) for the league year: in each round k (`round_count()`) the teams/2 matches of the list (the indices through table `table()`), and the list is freed (`exe::crt_vector_destructor_iterator` + `exe::crt_operator_delete`). Otherwise the round robin: for j = 1..legs (`legs()`)·(n − 1), the round through `exe::league_next_schedule_round` (push `league_flags()`; push `round_count()`; push `legs()`; push `club_count()`; push id; push &step; push round; add esp, 0x1c -> cdecl) and column j % (n − 1) (n − 1 at zero): each team i with opponent v ≠ 0 in the grid clears the opponent's slot; home advantage by the parity of v > 0, of the half ((j − 1)/(n − 1)) and of year + stage; with a fixed stadium (`fixed_stadium_id()`), the club whose stadium (`club::STADIUM`) it is stays at home. Each match goes to the calendar (`add_league_fixture`). At the end, the grid is freed and the type 3 dates of the table (`league_round_date::TV_SLOT_KIND`) take the matches to TV (`exe::league_move_fixtures_for_tv`). Returns 1.

Promotes and relegates between two leagues: the non-promotion clauses, the relegated clubs go down (relegation clauses, human manager sacked in a competition with no active record) and the promoted clubs go up, in pairs or all; the box if the counts differ from the expected ones. \n Ret 0x18: `league_promote_and_relegate(above, below, contracts, aos_pairs, sobem, descem)`, from the end of the leagues (after 2002-06-01). It receives the caller's ecx and passes it to `exe::league_move_club_to_division`, which does not read it: thiscall here to keep it. With `contracts`, the clubs of the lower league that do not go up (`league_table_row::STATUS` ≠ 0 and ≠ 5) trigger the non-promotion clauses (`exe::contract_manager_trigger_non_promotion_clauses`: push league; push club; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 8). In pairs: each relegated club from above (`league_table_row::STATUS` = 3) swaps with the first one below that goes up (`league_table_row::STATUS` = 0 or 5): that one goes up (`exe::league_move_club_to_division`: push 0; push upper competition; push club; caller's ecx -> thiscall, ret 0xc), the relegated one keeps the old competition (`club::LAST_DIVISION`) and takes the lower one (`club::DIVISION`), triggers the relegation clauses (`exe::contract_manager_trigger_relegation_clauses`: push old; push club; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 8) and, in a competition with no active record and with a human manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), loses the manager (`exe::manager_manager_remove_club_manager`: push 0; push 7; push 1; push club; mov ecx, `G_MANAGER_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 0x10); both end with `league_table_row::STATUS` = 0xff. Otherwise, all relegated clubs go down this way and then all the lower ones that go up go up. Counts that differ from the expected ones (0xff = any) give the box at line 0x15dc (going up) or 0x15e2 (going down).

Sorts the table (`exe::league_sort_table`), marks the bands (promotion, play-offs, 2 and relegation) from the top and the bottom, works out the best (`league_table_row::BEST_POSSIBLE_POSITION`) and worst (`league_table_row::WORST_POSSIBLE_POSITION`) possible position from the maximum points and decides the status (`league_table_row::STATUS`): title (5), promotion (0, 7 or 6), play-offs (1), relegation (3, with the clauses `exe::contract_manager_trigger_relegation_clauses`), 2 and 0xfe, each announced (`comp_vtable::ANNOUNCE_TEAM_STATUS`); the European place (`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE`) from the nation places (`exe::uefaseeding_get_nation_places`); the stats progress (`comp_vtable::SET_CLUB_PROGRESS`). \n Ret 0: `League::update_positions_and_status()`, virtual `league_vtable::UPDATE_POSITIONS_AND_STATUS` of the league (from the day pass 0x684946). `games_per_club()` (the season's matches) = (`club_count()` − 1) × `legs()` (16 bits) if still −1, with rows and `active()`. With `complete()`, nothing more. Otherwise sorts the table (League::sort_table `exe::league_sort_table`, thiscall(league, 0), ret 4) and builds the band map (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of `club_count()` bytes set to 0xff; out of memory: the box at line 0x7c9): from the top, counts `promoted_count()` (band 0, promotion) and `promotion_playoff_count()` (band 1, play-offs) on the rows not in 0xfe, 0xfc or 3; from the bottom, `relegated_count()` (band 3, relegation) and `relegation_playoff_count()` (band 2) on those not in 0, 1 or 5. With `league_flags::CHAMPION_STATUS` (bit 0 of `league_flags()`), the first in the table outside 0xfe, 0xfc and 3. The best position (`league_table_row::BEST_POSSIBLE_POSITION`) and the worst (`league_table_row::WORST_POSSIBLE_POSITION`) of each row not yet decided, from the maximum points (`max_points`) and the matches played (with `tiebreak_matches()` on a tie among those that finished). Then, row by row: worst = first + 1, the title (5); band 0 at the worst, promotion (0 with `league_flags()` bit 1; 7 with bit 2; 6 with bit 3) for those in 0xff or 1; band 1, play-offs (1) for those in 0xff; band 3 at the best, the relegation clauses (CONTRACT_MANAGER::trigger_relegation_clauses `exe::contract_manager_trigger_relegation_clauses`, thiscall(`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`, club, `competition()`), ret 8) and relegation (3) for those in 0xff, 2 or 0xfc; band 2 at the best, 2 for those in 0xff or 0xfe. Each new status is announced (`set_row_status`, `comp_vtable::ANNOUNCE_TEAM_STATUS`). With `league_flags()` bit 0x20, those between the bands with no band in the middle and in 0xff become 0xfe (announced with −2). Best = worst below 9, top league (`stage_index()` = `stage_index::MAIN`) that counts (`exe::comp_util_is_league_division`, cdecl(id)), without an upper division (`upper_division_id()` = −1) and a club with no European place (`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE` + 6 × id = −1) from a European nation (`KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE`) outside `KEY_NATION_SCOTLAND`: the nation's places (UefaSeeding::get_nation_places `exe::uefaseeding_get_nation_places`, thiscall(`G_UEFA_SEEDING`, nation, &cl, &uefa), ret 0xc) give the Champions League (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_EUROPEAN_CHAMPIONS_LEAGUE`) or the UEFA Cup (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP`). Finally virtual `comp_vtable::SET_CLUB_PROGRESS` (the status in the stats: club, `stage_index()`, position, best, worst) and the free (`exe::crt_free`) of the map.

Pays the prize money: divides the prize fund (`prize_fund()`) by 1 + 2 + ... + n and pays (n − i) shares to the club in table row i (`exe::finance_add_prize_money` on the finance record), with the prize news item above 1000; with `prize_mode()` = 3 the competition pays through virtual `comp_vtable::PAY_STAGE_PRIZE_MONEY`; with `prize_mode()` = 2, nothing. \n Ret 0: `League::pay_prize_money()`: with `prize_mode()` = 2, nothing. With `prize_mode()` = 3, the competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` by the id of `competition()`) pays through virtual `comp_vtable::PAY_STAGE_PRIZE_MONEY` (without the competition table: the box at line 0x1df). Otherwise the fund (`prize_fund()`) divided by 1 + 2 + … + n (n = `club_count()` table rows) is the share; the club of row i (`table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE` each) receives (n − i) shares in the finance record (`european_cup_club_finance`; `exe::finance_add_prize_money` adds to the balance, in +0xa8 and +0x148) and, above 1000, the prize news (`FN_COMP_SEND_PRIZE_MONEY_NEWS` with position i + 1).

Updates the staff records by status: 5 the title (`exe::staff_records_add_league_champions_record`), 0 promotion (`exe::staff_records_add_promotion_record`, weight 100), 3 relegation (`exe::staff_records_add_relegation_record`); returns 0. \n Ret 0x18: `club.update_staff_records_for_status(status, stage, out, _, _)` (virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_STAFF_RECORDS_FOR_STATUS` of the league): status 5, the title (Staff_Records `exe::staff_records_add_league_champions_record` of `G_STAFF_RECORDS` with the club and competition +4); 0, promotion (`exe::staff_records_add_promotion_record` with weight 100); 3, relegation (`exe::staff_records_add_relegation_record`). Returns 0 and does not write the output.

Announces a team's status: outside friendlies, calls the competition's virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_STAFF_RECORDS_FOR_STATUS` and builds news item 0xc (club, competition, stage, status, round, what the virtual returned), delivered by scope or, by status, to the nation, the division (and the promotion or relegation one) or the club's manager. \n Ret 0x14; SEH frame with no destructor: `club.announce_team_status(status, stage, _, _)`: friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition`), 0. Virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_STAFF_RECORDS_FOR_STATUS` of the competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` by the id of `competition()`) with the club, the status, the stage and the output (0xff); −1 from it: 0. The round (`stage_id()`; with stages, `stage_index()` = `stage_index::MAIN`, and stage ≠ 0xff: that of the stage, `league::STAGE_ID`). News 0xc (local): 0 the club, 1 the competition, 2 the stage, 3 the status, 4 the round, 5 what the virtual returned. Output ≠ 0xff: delivery by scope (`exe::news_send_by_scope` with the club's nation and the continent). Otherwise by status: 5, to the competition's nation (`FN_NEWS_SEND_TO_NATION_MANAGERS`) without an upper division (`upper_division_id()`), to the division (`exe::news_send_to_division_managers`) with it; 0 and 3, to the division and to the competition's promotion (+0x1c) or relegation (+0x20) division, if any; 1 and 2, to the division; 6, 7 and 0xfe, to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`). Returns 1.

Adds a result to the league: stamps today's date on the league; a stage fixture goes to its stage; otherwise adds the fixture to the table (`exe::league_apply_result_to_table`) and to the competition stats (`exe::comp_stats_record_match_result`) and returns 1. \n Ret 8: `fixture.add_result(match)`: stores the day's date in `league::LAST_RESULT_DATE` (`exe::date_operator_3d` of `G_CURRENT_DATE`); league with stages (`stage_index()` = 0xff) and a fixture of a stage (`fixture::STAGE_INDEX` ≠ 0xff): the stage (`stages()` + 4 × stage, up to `current_stage()`) receives the fixture through virtual `comp_vtable::ADD_RESULT` and what it returns is returned; stage out of range: the boxes and 0. Fixture of another stage (`fixture::STAGE_INDEX` ≠ `stage_index()`, which is not 0xfe): 0. Otherwise adds the fixture to the table (`exe::league_apply_result_to_table` on table `table()` with the `club_count()` rows, marking) and, outside stages 0xfe (`stage_index::SPECIAL_STAGE`), with the competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` by the id of `competition()`) and its stats (+8) and with the match: `exe::comp_stats_record_match_result` with the points of both; returns 1. Null fixture: the box and −1.

Allocates and returns a copy of the table rows, with new head-to-head and form buffers; sets `games_per_club()` when it is −1. \n Ret 0: `League::copy_table()`: no table (`table()`) or no rows (`club_count()`): 0. With `games_per_club()` = −1, writes (rows − 1) × `legs()` into it (16 bits; more than 50 rows: the box at line 0x1059 first, as in the original). Allocates the rows (`exe::crt_malloc`, 0x3b each; out of memory: box 0x1061 and 0) and copies them; with head-to-head on the first row (+5), each row gets a new vector of (rows − 1) × 14 bytes with a copy of its own; with form (+9), one of `games_per_club()` bytes. Returns the copy. The vector allocations are not checked (as in the original).

Sorts the table's clubs by strength and stores each one's predicted position in the competition stats. \n Ret 0: `League::set_predicted_positions()`: without stats (`comp_stats()`): the box (line 0x189e). Copies the clubs of the `club_count()` table rows (`table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE` each) into a vector (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory: box 0x18a6, without freeing), sorts by strength (`exe::comp_util_sort_clubs_by_strength`) and stores position i + 1 of each non-null club in the stats (`exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position`); frees the vector (`exe::crt_free`).
qsort comparator of projection entries by club reputation (`club::REPUTATION`), highest first

Projects each table club's end-of-season points (in the first third of the season, by a reputation scale), sorts them and hands the club's positions in normal, better (× 1.5) and worse (× 0.444) form to virtual `comp_vtable::SET_CLUB_PROGRESS`. \n Ret 4; virtual +0x84 of the leagues, called only by Comp_Stats `exe::comp_stats_get_club_projected_positions`, which the board uses in the weekly confidence 0x697c40 and in the reason for the manager leaving `get_departure_reason`: `club.update_projected_positions()`: with the club in the table (`table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE` bytes, count `club_count()`: +0 the club, `league_table_row::PLAYED` the matches, `league_table_row::POINTS` the points), builds in a block (`exe::crt_operator_new`) one 0xe-byte entry per row with the points per match (`league_projection::POINTS_PER_GAME`); in the first third of the season (club's matches × 3 < `games_per_club()`), replaces them with a scale by reputation (0.83 × `win_points()` (`rdata::F64_0_83`) for the first down to 0.23 × `win_points()` (`rdata::F64_0_23`) below the last). Projects the end-of-season points (`league_projection::PROJECTED_POINTS`), sorts and finds the club's position in normal, better (× 1.5, `rdata::F64_1_5`) and worse (× 0.444, `rdata::F64_0_4444444444`) form; frees the block and hands the three to virtual `comp_vtable::SET_CLUB_PROGRESS` (`set_club_progress(club, competition stage_index(), normal, better, worse)`, which writes bytes +0x73..+0x75 of the club's record in Comp_Stats). Returns 1; outside the table, 0.

Puts the club in table row i: totals cleared, status 0xff, mark, total rounds (`games_per_club()`) if still −1, position history and, under rule 4, the head-to-head entries (the last row fills every row's opponents). \n Ret 0x10: `i.init_table_row(club, mark, rows)`: puts the club in row `i` (char) of table `rows` (null: the league's, `table()`): a club with status `professional_status()` = 3 (`professional_status::AMATEUR`) changes to 2 (`professional_status::SEMI_PROFESSIONAL`); total rounds `games_per_club()` still −1 becomes (clubs `club_count()` − 1) × legs `legs()` (more than 50 clubs: box and continues); the row gets the club, position `i`, the three totals blocks zeroed, the mark (`set_mark`), status 0xff (`table_status::UNDECIDED`), 1 in `set_best_possible_position` and the clubs (`set_worst_possible_position`); with legs, the position history (`set_position_history`, `games_per_club()` bytes; out of memory, box and end); with rule 4 (`uses_head_to_head_rule`), the head-to-head entries (`set_h2h_entries`, 14 bytes per opponent, zeroed). On the last row with head-to-head, each row receives the opponents in table order.
each club still in the league division stores last season's division (`club::LAST_DIVISION`) and the final position (`set_last_position`)

Applies a result to the table: finds the home and away rows and adds the game at home and away (played, goals, win/draw/loss, by extra time and penalties, marking `fixture::HOME_RESULT_MARK`/`fixture::AWAY_RESULT_MARK`), the win points by the `league_vtable::POINTS_FOR_RESULT` virtual and the draw points `draw_points()`; redoes the totals, returns both rows' points and adds the head-to-head (`exe::league_update_head_to_head`). \n Ret 0x18: `fixture.apply_result_to_table(table, n, mark, pts_home*, pts_away*)`: finds the rows of the home side (`home_club()`) and the away side (`away_club()`) among the `n` (short) of the table (stops at the first club that is neither after finding both) and adds the game: matches (`league_table_row::HOME_PLAYED`/`league_table_row::AWAY_PLAYED`), goals (`league_table_row::HOME_GOALS_FOR`/`league_table_row::HOME_GOALS_AGAINST` and `league_table_row::AWAY_GOALS_FOR`/`league_table_row::AWAY_GOALS_AGAINST`: the score of `home_goals_extra_time()`/`away_goals_extra_time()` when ≠ 0xff, otherwise that of `home_goals()`/`away_goals()`). The result from score `home_goals()`/`away_goals()`; level: by extra time (`tie_rules()` & `fixture_tie_rules::EXTRA_TIME`, `home_goals_extra_time()`/`away_goals_extra_time()`; `mark` writes 3 (`result_mark::WON_EXTRA_TIME`) in `fixture::HOME_RESULT_MARK`/`fixture::AWAY_RESULT_MARK`) and by penalties (bits 0x20/1, `home_penalties()`/`away_penalties()`; a home win counts as a draw for it; 5 with 0x20 (`fixture_tie_rules::SHOOT_OUT_35_YARD`), otherwise 4); a pure draw with the league's draw points (`draw_points()`). The win points through virtual `league_vtable::POINTS_FOR_RESULT` (`points_for_result`) of the type 2 competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, `league::COMP_TYPE`) or of the league itself, read on each call. Redoes the totals of both rows and returns the points (`league_table_row::POINTS`) in `pts_home`/`pts_away` (0 without the row). With head-to-head on the first row (+5), finds the opponent in each one and adds the tie (`exe::league_update_head_to_head`). No SEH, no random draw, no box, all locals written before being read.

Returns the points for a result: the win points (`win_points()`) to the winner, 0 to the loser; when level, by extra time (`match_rules()` bit 2), by penalties (bits 0x21: the draw points `draw_points()` to the winner) or the draw points. \n Ret 8: `club.points_for_result(fixture)`: the win points (`win_points()`) if the club won (home side `home_club()` with `home_goals()` > `away_goals()`, away side `away_club()` with fewer), otherwise 0; level: by extra time (`match_rules()` bit 2, `home_goals_extra_time()`/`away_goals_extra_time()`, the win points), by penalties (bits 0x21, `home_penalties()`/`away_penalties()`: the draw points `draw_points()` to the winner, 0 to the loser) or the draw points. Only al is written: the 3 high bytes of eax are those of the fixture.

qsort callback comparing table rows with head-to-head: the own compare, the points, the club id with no games, the stored head-to-head position (+4) and the name. \n `league_compare_table_rows_h2h(a, b)` (qsort callback of `sort_table` under rule 4 and of `ita_league_sort_clubs_level_on_points` of the Italian Serie B): an empty row ties; the own comparison `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CUSTOM_COMPARE_FUNC` when it does not give 0 (called again); the points (`league_table_row::POINTS` of column `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CURRENT_LEAGUE` → `league::TABLE_COLUMN`, b − a); both without matches (`league_table_row::PLAYED`): the club id (a − b); the head-to-head position stored in +4 (b − a); finally the clubs' name (+4, strcmp: −1, 0 or 1).

Sorts the table by the rules (`league::TIEBREAKS`): rule 6 only sorts (`league_compare_table_rows`); rule 4 builds the mini table and, when first, sorts by head-to-head (`league_compare_table_rows_h2h`) and bubbles the ties; stores the position (`set_position`) and the position history (`position_history()`); returns 1. \n `rows.sort_table()`: sorts the table (`rows` null: the league's, `table()`). First fixes total rounds `games_per_club()` (−1: (`club_count()` − 1) × `legs()`, with clubs and `active()`). Rule 6 (`league::TIEBREAKS`, without column `table_column()`) only sorts (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `league_compare_table_rows`); rule 4 with head-to-head builds the mini table (`exe::league_rank_by_head_to_head`) and, being the first rule, sorts with `league_compare_table_rows_h2h` and runs a bubble pass over the league rows (`table()`) while there are swaps: a tie on points (or on the own comparison `custom_compare()`) decided by `exe::league_compare_table_rows`; otherwise qsort with `league_compare_table_rows`. Finally (`stage_index()` ≠ `stage_index::SPECIAL_STAGE`, without column) stores the position in `set_position` and in history `position_history()` (round `played()` up to `games_per_club()`). Keeps the league in `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CURRENT_LEAGUE` and the own comparison in `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CUSTOM_COMPARE_FUNC`. Returns 1. No SEH, no random draw.

Builds the head-to-head mini table of the clubs level on points with their summed head-to-head results, sorted by `exe::league_compare_h2h_rows`; the position (+4) starts at the club count and drops at each separated pair. \n `rows.build_h2h_table()` (unnamed in the community map): a mini table (calloc `exe::crt_calloc` of `club_count()` rows) with the club of each row and, for each other club with the same points (`league_table_row::POINTS`), the sum of the head-to-head against it (entry of `league_table_row::H2H_ENTRIES`: bytes +4..+7 into +0x11..+0x14, words +8/+0xa/+0xc into +0x15/+0x17/+0x19); sorts with `league_compare_h2h_rows` and writes in +4 of each row the position, which starts at the number of clubs and drops at each pair of the mini table that `exe::league_compare_h2h_rows` separates. Frees the mini table (`exe::crt_free`). Out of memory: the original routine (the league.cpp box). TapeCall through `sort_table` under rule 4.

Frees the +5 and +9 row buffers and the table (null: the league's, then clears `club_count()` and `table()`). \n `table.free_table()`: a null `table` = the league's (`table()`). With clubs (`club_count()` ≥ 1) and a table: frees (`exe::crt_free`) the +5 vectors of each row (if the first row's is not null), then the +9 ones (likewise) and the table; if it is the league's, zeroes `club_count()` and `table()` (`set_club_count(0)`, `set_table(0)`). No SEH, no random draw.

Returns 1 when every club has played the `games_per_club()` rounds (and the stages, if asked); at the end of the league, the records (`exe::staff_records_add_league_finish_records`), the prize money (`exe::league_pay_prize_money`), the notice (`league_vtable::UPDATE_POSITIONS_AND_STATUS`) and `complete()`. \n `stages.check_complete(warn)`: 0 without a table, closed (`stopped()`) or without `active()`. Outside the single stage (`stage_index()` ≠ `stage_index::MAIN`) already complete (`complete()`): 1. Not complete: fixes total rounds `games_per_club()` (−1) and, if some club has not yet played them all (`league_table_row::PLAYED` < `games_per_club()`), 0; otherwise, in league divisions (`exe::comp_util_is_league_division`) with `round_count()` > 8 and without `tiebreak_matches()`, the end-of-league records (`exe::staff_records_add_league_finish_records`), and without `tiebreak_matches()` the prizes (`exe::league_pay_prize_money`). With `stages` = 1 in the single stage: each stage of `stages()` (0..=`current_stage()`) must be complete (virtual `comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with 0, 1) and `current_stage()` ≥ `stage_count()` − 1, otherwise 0. Marks `complete()` (before that, with `warn`, virtual `league_vtable::UPDATE_POSITIONS_AND_STATUS`) and returns 1. No SEH, no random draw.

Pays TV rights: adds the amount to the TV revenue of every club in the table (with a filter, only those with `last_division()` equal to it) and sends the news (`exe::comp_send_tv_rights_news`). \n `value.pay_tv_rights(filter)`: with the finance table `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, for each club in the table (`table()`; with `filter`, only those whose `last_division()` equals it) adds `value` to the TV revenue (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` → `exe::finance_add_tv_revenue`) and sends the news (Comp::send_tv_rights_news `exe::comp_send_tv_rights_news`, only for a club with a human manager). No SEH, no random draw, no locals.

Records the season honours: champion, runner-up and third into the history (`exe::comp_util_add_history_record`), with the host nation's national side as the featured entry when the competition asks (`comp_vtable::HAS_HOST_COUNTRY`, `exe::hostcountry_find_hosts`, `exe::database_get_national_team`); a champion of this division clears `club::LAST_DIVISION` of the clubs pointing at it. \n `League::record_season_honours()`: champion, runner-up and (with more than 2 clubs) third of the table (`table()`). If the champion's division (`division()`) is this competition (`competition()`), zeroes in the clubs (`club_at`, `G_CLUB_COUNT` − `G_NATION_COUNT`) the `club::LAST_DIVISION` that points at it. If virtual `comp_vtable::HAS_HOST_COUNTRY` of the competition's league (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`[id]) asks, the featured entry is the national side (`exe::database_get_national_team`) of the host country (HostCountry::find_hosts `exe::hostcountry_find_hosts` with year `year()`): with two hosts, the one with the higher `nation::REPUTATION` (tie: the first). Writes into the history (`exe::comp_util_add_history_record`) and returns what it returns. No SEH, no random draw; the two host locals are only read when `exe::hostcountry_find_hosts` writes them.

Stores in a league schedule round record the date with a relative year, the code and a value. \n The date (Date::Date, `exe::date_date_549f70`, into a local Date) from `day`/`month`/(`years` + `base`)/`week` in record `i` (signed word, 0x41 bytes) of `rounds`: day of the year in word +0, year − `base` in word `league_round_date::YEAR_OFFSET`, `code` in byte `league_round_date::TIME_SLICE` and `value` in `league_round_date::VENUE_VALUE`. Returns the record.

Returns the league match importance for the club: the league base, +1 early in the season or with the final-day margin. \n Ret 0xc: the importance of the `fixture` for the club on `side` (0 = home, +0x1c; otherwise +0x20): (byte `importance()` of the league − 10) / 4 + 10. Writes 0xff into `out`; with the club in the table (`table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE`-byte rows, `club_count()` clubs) and more than 10 rounds (`round_count()`): +1 with `round_number()` of the fixture below 3; otherwise, a row with no mark (`status()` = `table_status::UNDECIDED`), +1 and the last-day margin (`exe::league_final_day_margin_needed`, which can change the importance) in `out`. Only al is returned (the caller uses al).

The qsort comparison of the table rows: points, the league tie-break rules and the club id. \n Compares table rows `a` and `b` (`[+0]` club). Current league in `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CURRENT_LEAGUE`, the table column in `table_column()` (14 bytes per column in the rows). Row without a club: 0. With the private comparison in `G_LEAGUE_SORT_CUSTOM_COMPARE_FUNC` and its answer non-zero: it again. Otherwise points (+0x19) descending; both without matches (+0x11): by club id. Then the league's four criteria (`league::TIEBREAKS`): 1 goal difference, 2 goals for, 3 byte +0x12, 4 byte +4 (`position()`), 5 word `away_goals_for()` (in column 0, criterion 6 = byte +4 and stop); in column 0 with both at the league's number of matches (`played()` = `games_per_club()`), the id of the clubs' `club::STADIUM`; finally the club id.

On the last matchday, returns the goal margin a club needs for the title, the top places or survival, and sets the deciding-match flag. \n Ret 8: on the last day (matches `played()` ≥ league rounds `round_count()` − 1) and a row with no mark (`status()` = `table_status::UNDECIDED`), the goal margin the club needs for the title, the top places (`promoted_count()`/`promotion_playoff_count()`) or to escape the bottom ones (`relegation_playoff_count()`/`relegated_count()`); 0xff if none. With points equal to the club ahead and no possible margin, writes 0x14 into `out` (deciding) and returns 0 or 0xff. Only al is returned (the caller uses al).

The ordering of the head-to-head mini table: points and the league tie-breakers. \n qsort callback: an empty row ties; otherwise points (`points()`), and then the league's criteria (`G_LEAGUE_SORT_CURRENT_LEAGUE` + `league::TIEBREAKS`, up to 4; 0 ends): 1 goal difference (`goals_for()` − `goals_against()`), 2 goals for (`goals_for()`), 3 byte `won()`, 5 word `away_goals_for()`; 4 and the others do not decide. Returns b − a at the first criterion that differs.

Adds one match to the head-to-head record (played, result, goals and points). \n Ret 0x14: adds a match to the head-to-head entry: matches (+4), wins (+5, with the league's win points `win_points()`), draws (+6, draw points `draw_points()`) or defeats (+7), goals for (`h2h_entry::GOALS_FOR`) and against (`h2h_entry::GOALS_AGAINST`); the points in `h2h_entry::POINTS`. Negative row or opponent: nothing.
does the competition have `promoted_count()` and flag 2 of `league_flags()`?
the record (`league_table_row::SIZE` bytes) of table `table()`

Returns the next position in the calendar rotation (special league, jumps of 3 by random draw, wrapping at n). \n The next position `pos` in the calendar rotation of `n` (word) clubs. In the special league (`league` = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_EUROPEAN_CHAMPIONS_LEAGUE`): 2 becomes 4, 5 becomes 3, the rest advance 1. With fewer than 2 legs (`turnos`) or 8 rounds (`rounds`), or the 0x40 flag (`marks`), advances 1; with 0x80, advances 1 swapping n/2 for n−1 and n for n/2. Otherwise the state `*step_towards` (0..3) alternates jumps: 1 and 2 go back 1 (below 0, n−1) and move to 2 and 3; 3 jumps 3 and goes back to 0; 0 jumps 3 (moving to 1) if `pos` < n−5 and random(4) (`exe::utils_random`) ≥ 2, otherwise advances 1; the jumps wrap around at n.

Stores a round match (three bytes and a dword). \n Writes match `j` 0..7 of round `round` (0x41 bytes each, 7 per match starting at `base`): `league_round_date::TV_SLOT_WEEKDAY` `a` (−1..6), `league_round_date::TV_SLOT_TIME_SLICE` `b` (−1..2), `league_round_date::TV_SLOT_KIND` `c` (−1..4) and `league_round_date::TV_SLOT_DATA` the dword `value`. Out of range: the original routine (error boxes, and it writes anyway).

Moves the club to a division: the current division becomes last season's and the new one is set; clears the division clauses (and the squad numbers when the new one uses them), opens the requested manager vacancy, upgrades the stadium to the league minimum and turns status 3 into 2. \n Ret 0xc; `this` is not read: `club.move_club_to_division(division, slot)`: the current division (`club::DIVISION`) becomes last season's (`club::LAST_DIVISION`) and the new one goes in; the players' division clauses are cleared (`exe::contract_manager_reset_division_clauses` on `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`), also the squad numbers if the old division did not use them and the new one does (`exe::squad_manager_club_uses_squad_numbers` on `G_SQUAD_MANAGER`, before and after); with `slot` and no manager (`manager()`), the manager vacancy (`exe::manager_manager_add_job_vacancy` on `G_MANAGER_MANAGER`); in a league division (`comp_type()` = `comp_type::LEAGUE` in competition `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`[id]) with a minimum stadium (`required_capacity()` ≠ −1) and a stadium record (`stadium()`), the stadium works (`exe::finance_upgrade_stadium_for_league` on the finances `exe::financetable_get_club_finance` of `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, seats `required_seats()` and `required_capacity()`); and, with the competition loaded, status `professional_status()` = 3 (`professional_status::AMATEUR`) changes to 2 (`professional_status::SEMI_PROFESSIONAL`).

Shuffles the league table with the seeded rand and puts clubs sharing a ground, clubs with linked grounds, and Celtic and Rangers in paired slots. \n Ret 4: `clubs.draw_team_order()`: shuffles the league table (`table()`, `club_count()` records of 59 bytes, `CUP_LEAGUE_TABLE_ROW_SIZE`) for the fixture grid: keeps a random draw (`exe::utils_random`, 30000), seeds the CRT rand (`exe::crt_srand`) with `year()` + `G_GAME_RANDOM_SEED` and swaps n random pairs (`exe::crt_rand` × n / 0x8000), then restores the seed (draw + 1). League with flag 0x100 (`league_flags::FIXED_TABLE_SLOTS`) in `league_flags()`: each club goes to the slot that virtual table +0xa8 says (if free), the others to the first free ones, and +0xac receives each slot. Otherwise: in Scotland (`competition()` = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_SCOTTISH_PREMIER_DIVISION`) Celtic and Rangers (`G_KEY_CLUB_GLASGOW_CELTIC`, `G_KEY_CLUB_GLASGOW_RANGERS`) go to slots 0 and clubs / 2, in random order (`exe::utils_random`, 2); clubs of the same stadium (`club::STADIUM`) and then those of linked stadiums (`stadium::NEARBY_STADIUM`) go in pairs to slots k and clubs / 2 + k (past half of the clubs, the box); the others to the first free slots. The grid (`exe::crt_operator_new`, freed with `exe::crt_operator_delete`) goes back to the table. Out of memory: the box (line 0xed3).

For each table row, moves the club's professional status (`club::PROFESSIONAL_STATUS`) to the value (down or up) when the row status is not the excluded one and when it is the included one (0xfd = none). \n Ret 0x10: `value.limit_club_division_tier(away, inside, baixar)` (called by the season end of each league: Argentina, Belgium, Brazil, Croatia, Denmark, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Italy, Russia, Scotland, Sweden and Turkey): for each table row (`table()`, `league_table_row::SIZE` bytes, count `club_count()`), adjusts the professional status of the club (+0) to `value` (`cap_professional_status`) when the row status (`league_table_row::STATUS`) is not `away` (0xfd = none) and again when it is `inside` (0xfd = none). The first three arguments are bytes pushed as dwords: only the low byte counts.

Writes the region name (1..14): from the language 4, 5 and 9 tables with the adjective form, otherwise the translated adjective or noun by form. \n `get_region_name(region, text, size, form)`: clears the text and writes the name of the region (1..14, signed byte). Form (byte) other than 0xff with language (`FN_LANGLIB_GET_LANGUAGE`) 4, 5 or 9: the text from the language's table, read by address (`[0x9d0518 + 4 × (4 × region + f)]`, `[0x9d06d4 + 4 × (5 × region + f)]`, `[0x9d05f8 + 4 × (4 × region + f)]`, with f the adjective form from `exe::get_adjective_form_index`, already in Rust, called through the game's address), copied. Otherwise, through `FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`: in languages 2, 4, 5 and 9 the adjective with form 0xff and the noun with the others; in the rest the opposite; the Caribbean: "Caribbean" in languages 2, 4, 5 and 9, otherwise the region texts (form 0xff) or regionality texts, with the empty string 0xad9c64. Returns 1. Null text, region out of range or size (signed short) < 100: the original (error box). Used in the region order (`get_regions_sorted_by_name`, in Rust), in the player search (player_search, search_screens) and in screens without a module (0x7db360, 0x7e13d0, 0x7e29e0).

Writes the continent adjective: the record's own (`continent::ADJECTIVE`) or, in languages 9, 5 and 4, the text by continent and adjective form. \n The community map gives 629 bytes; the routine runs to 0x6181c5: 2518. `get_continent_adjective(continent, text, size, form)`: clears the text and copies the continent's adjective. Form (byte) 0 or language (`FN_LANGLIB_GET_LANGUAGE`) other than 9, 5 and 4: the record's own adjective (`continent::ADJECTIVE`). Otherwise the language's text by continent (id +0 compared with the keys `KEY_CONTINENT_AFRICA`, `KEY_CONTINENT_ASIA`, `KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE`, `KEY_CONTINENT_NORTH_AMERICA`, `KEY_CONTINENT_OCEANIA`, in that order) and by the adjective form (`FN_GET_ADJECTIVE_FORM_INDEX`, already in Rust, through the game's address). Returns 1. Null continent or text, or size (signed short) < 50: the original (0). Used in the search (find_screens), the Menubar, the day's matches (`open_day_fixtures_screen`, in Rust) and 0x7dd400.

the record's injury in the injury list (`injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST` of [0xb63d28]): same injury adds the severity (up to 100), another keeps the worse; a new record goes to the list (`FN_LLIST_ADD_TAIL`, the record built on the stack checked by the tape). No list: the original (creates the list)

can the player earn highlight `code` (0x1f40..0x21e4)? Not if the side already had it (table at engine +0x21e) or the record is from outside; 0x219e..0x21b8 with rules on performance, goals, cards, time on the pitch and the history search (`FN_MEDIA_HAS_LOGGED_STORY`, last 7 or 30 days). Compared side by side

Posts the news of a player's return to light or full training; with a type 12 category, also resolves the outcome of the treatment, the return and the holidays (contract grievances, happiness, liking for the manager, chance of going absent and personality attribute changes). \n `Injury::post_recovery_news(p, estagio, kind, force, days)`, from the returns to training (`post_due_recovery_news`) and from the end of the injury (`end_player_injury`); SEH frame for the local news. Without a player: nothing; without `force`, only for a club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) with a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`). News 2001 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the stage, the type, the id, the three names, the birth date, the year and the days (`exe::newsitem_set_slot`, data 0..8). Category type 12 (the table of 13-byte entries at 0x9e7ad9): random(32000) and: type 'Q' (holidays): with a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`), player sheet and club, each contract grievance (`contract::GRIEVANCES`: 0x20000, 0x20, 0x40) drops (`exe::staff_contract_clear_grievances`) with random(`staff::PROFESSIONALISM`) > random(25); if none drops, random(`staff::PROFESSIONALISM`) 0 leads to the chance of going absent (with the absences manager `G_AWOL` and `staff::LOYALTY` below 12, random(`staff::LOYALTY`) < random(5): the absence `exe::awol_start_absence` with 4 and the news is not posted); otherwise the contract happiness (`contract::MORALE`) rises 15 (−100..100) and, with a dropped flag, the manager likes him more (`like_manager_more`, outcome 2); then random(`staff::PROFESSIONALISM` + `staff::LOYALTY`, − 5 with player sheet value `player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION` above 7250) < random(20) and random(4) adjusts `staff::AMBITION`, `staff::TEMPERAMENT`, `player_sheet::WORK_RATE` of the player sheet and `staff::LOYALTY`. Stage 0, type 'M' (treatment): 0 gives outcome 2 (form `physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` = 0xff, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0); below 5, outcome 1 (`physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0); otherwise outcome 0 and, with `staff::TEMPERAMENT` below 5, the manager (`club::MANAGER`) may lose sympathy (`exe::staff_is_favoured_by`/`staff_remove_favoured_staff`, random(`staff::TEMPERAMENT`) 0: rejected `exe::staff_add_disliked_staff`); `staff::LOYALTY` (or `staff::AMBITION`) above 10: the manager likes him more. Stage 1, types 'O' and 'N': the outcome by the random draw, the form, and the flag `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) is cleared. Data 9 (outcome) and 10; delivery by the reach `force` (`exe::news_send_by_scope`: the club, the nation of the club or of the person (`club::NATION`, `staff::NATION`), and her continent).

Returns the translated injury category name and the name's gender in language 3. \n `injury_get_category_name(category, text, size)` (stdcall, ret 0xc): the translated name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) of injury category 0..12 (internal, foot, shin, knee, thigh, groin, upper body, hand, arm, shoulder, neck, head, rehabilitation); otherwise the box (line 0x10e7). Returns 2 with language 3 (`exe::langlib_get_language`), otherwise 0 (the name's gender). Size below 20: the box (line 0x10d0) and al zeroed.

Records an injury: replaces the previous one only for some types, finds or grows the slot, and records the match, the length, the return to training, the date, the news, the recurrence, the national team, the relapse, the retirement and the outbreak. \n `Injury::add_injury(kind_arg, retroativa, p, game, surto, news, rec_arg, so_recorrencia)`, from the injuries day (`injury_daily_update`), the physical effects of the match (`apply_match_effects`), the initial records (`init_records`), the relapse (`roll_recurring_injury`), the illness outbreaks (`spread_illness_outbreaks`) and two original routines; frame of 0x220 bytes without SEH. Null person, no player sheet (`.player()`) or type outside 0..0x51: as in the original (box and −1); id beyond `G_STAFF_COUNT`: −1. The day's fitness (`exe::injury_update_player_fitness`) and the training (`G_TRAINING_MANAGER`, `exe::training_manager_update_player_training` with 0). Recurrence only: with a recurrence and a type that can recur (`G_INJURY_TYPE_CAN_RECUR`), the record's relapse flag (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` type, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE`: 1 if random(rec / 10) and random(rec) both give zero with a negative rec; rec if positive); −1. Otherwise, with an injury (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` ≠ −1): only types 0x4d, 0x4e, 0x4f and 0x51 replace it (the remaining days `days_left()` are kept, the old one goes to the history `exe::file_llist_add_node` and the slot is freed). `physical_record::LAST_INJURY_TYPE` = type; the first free slot (byte 0xff) of the vector `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRIES` (count `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRY_COUNT`) or 100 more slots (realloc; out of memory, the box for line 0x909 and −1). The type in the slot; the match (through the home club `home_club()` or the away club `away_club()` that has the person among the 50 of the squad `club::SQUAD`) writes the match record at +1 (`exe::fill_match_record_from_fixture`), otherwise `injury_entry::MATCH_MARK` = 0xff. The club's best physio (`exe::non_player_attribute_rating` of the three `club::PHYSIOS` with `non_player::PHYSIOTHERAPY`). Days = base (`G_INJURY_TYPE_BASE_DAYS`) + variable (`G_INJURY_TYPE_VARIABLE_DAYS`) × (35 − best) / 20 (minus a random draw of them if random(best + 5) > random(20); 0 for type 0x51) + the remaining days of the old one (+ random draws by age and by proneness `injury_proneness()` of the player sheet, with base above 10). The `staff_state::INJURY_COUNTER` of the 79-byte record goes up 1 for each zero of random(5 × `natural_fitness()` + 12), per day, up to 100. A current injury (`retroativa` 0): of 100 days, outside the human club and outside the list, the club's flag 100 in the watch list (`shortlist_manager_fields::CLUB_SHORTLISTS`); days ≥ random(50) + 30, the clubs targeting the player suspend it (`exe::shortlist_manager_suspend_clubs_shortlisting_player`). `injury_entry::DAYS_OUT` = `injury_entry::DAYS_LEFT` = days, `injury_entry::TRAINING_RETURN_DAYS` = `injury_entry::TRAINING_DAYS_LEFT` = the return to training (the type's percentage, at most 60 days before the end; `return_to_training_days`); `injury_entry::DATE` = the date (today, or today − random(days) − 1 when retroactive). The fitness again, the news (`exe::injury_post_injury_news`), `physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` = the slot, the recurrence, the national team (`exe::nationalteams_withdraw_injured_player`), `physical_record::TRAINING_NEWS_SENT` = 0, the relapse (`exe::injury_roll_recurring_injury`), the relapse count (from two: retirement `exe::player_regen_schedule_injury_retirement` by random draw), the retirement by age and by a long return to training, and the outbreak (`exe::injury_add_illness_outbreak`) for types 0, 1 and 2. Returns the slot.

Posts injury news 2000 (the person, type, date, days, birth date and match): over 100 days, to everyone if the world reputation is above 8000, otherwise to the interested clubs; up to 100, to the human club, the contract club and the national team. \n `injury_post_injury_news(p, l, arg)`. The function map gives it as stdcall: the original replaces ecx with `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER` right at entry; the only call site, in `add_injury`, puts the Injury in ecx: thiscall with this unused; ret 0xc; SEH frame without destructor. The interested clubs (`exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` on `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER` with 0x5a, up to 30) and the national team (`national_job()`) if it fits; news 0x7d0 (local): 0..3 the person (id and the `names::ID` of `staff::FIRST_NAME`/`staff::SECOND_NAME`/`staff::COMMON_NAME`, 0 if missing), 4 = the type, 5/6 = the injury date (`date()` signed, `date_year()` unsigned), 7 = the days (`days_out()`), 8/9 = the birth date (`date_of_birth()`, `date_of_birth_year()`), 0xa..0xc = the match record (`match_club_id()`, `match_opponent_id()`, +9) or −1 with no match (`match_mark()` = 0xff), 0xd = arg, 0xe = the club id or −1, 0xf = 0x420e9; the match in the news (`exe::write_match_record_to_news` with byte 0x10). Over 100 days: with world reputation (`world_reputation()` of the player sheet) above 8000, to everyone (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); otherwise to the interested clubs (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`). Up to 100: a human club (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`), to the club; the contract club (`injury_main_contract_stored`, `injury_club_of_contract`) if it is a different one; the national team.

Daily injury update: frees the match knock list, lowers the injury counters, on day 180 of the first season updates everyone's fitness, draws the training injuries on weekdays, then posts the return news and spreads the outbreaks. \n `Injury::daily_update()`, from the day loop (0x5cccd0) and from advancing to the start date (0x5cc850), every day: frees the match knock list (`injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST`, `exe::drop_llist` and `exe::crt_operator_delete`); the two counters (`injury_entry::DAYS_LEFT`, `injury_entry::TRAINING_DAYS_LEFT`) of each injury in the table (0x30 bytes at `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRIES`, count `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRY_COUNT`) go down by one; on day 180 of the first season (`exe::date_operator_3c` with the start date `G_GAME_START_DATE`), everyone's fitness (`exe::injury_update_player_fitness`). Except on Saturday and Sunday (`exe::date_get_weekday`: 5 and 6), the training injuries (`roll_training_injuries`): `G_STAFF_COUNT` / 150 random draws (at least 10) of a person: a player (`.player()`) — otherwise the draw does not count — in jobs 11, 13 and 15 (`job_for_club()`), present (`exe::awol_is_player_awol`), uninjured (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` = −1), passing the risk draws (the player sheet's `injury_proneness()`, the proneness `physical_record::PRONENESS` and the recurrence `physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE`/`physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` of the 31-byte record; rating 20 (`goalkeeper()`): random(5) against random(2)), one in three and proneness of 20: the category (the recurrence's, or drawn by the bands 0x9e7f05/0x9e7f06), the type (`exe::injury_choose_injury_type`, serious in the first 1/14 of the draws), the attributes the injury wears (`apply_injury_attribute_loss`: +0x1b, +0x36, +0x1d of the player sheet) and the new injury (`exe::injury_add_injury`); outside the season (`exe::injury_player_in_close_season`) nothing; category 7 with a rating below 15 does not count. At the end the return news (`exe::injury_post_due_recovery_news`) and the illness outbreaks (`exe::injury_spread_illness_outbreaks`).

At the human managers' clubs, posts the light training return news and updates the daily fitness of injured players; then processes the return queue: entries due today get the news and past entries leave the front. \n `Injury::post_due_recovery_news()`, from the injuries day (`injury_daily_update`), every day; SEH frame only for the local dates. At the clubs of the 16 human managers (the last 16 persons of `G_STAFF_TABLE`), each squad player (50 slots, `club.squad()`) who is injured (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY`): on the day when start (`injury_entry::DATE`) + days to light training (`training_return_days()`, more than 5) is reached, the light training return news (`exe::injury_post_recovery_news`, once: `physical_record::TRAINING_NEWS_SENT` of the 31-byte record) and the day's fitness (`exe::injury_update_player_fitness`). Then the return queue (`injury_fields::RECOVERY_NEWS_QUEUE`, 22 bytes: +0 date A, +8 date B, `recovery_news_entry::PERSON_ID` id, `recovery_news_entry::FORCE_DELIVERY` and `recovery_news_entry::INJURY_TYPE` what the news carries, count `injury_fields::RECOVERY_NEWS_COUNT`): those with date A today (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `compare_call_up_records_by_date`, stepping back while not before today, `exe::date_operator_3e`) give the news with the days between B and A (`exe::date_get_difference`); those with date B today (bsearch with `injury_compare_entry_dates`) the full return news; those with date B already past leave the front of the queue.

Applies a match's physical effects: for the 20 slots of each side, the recovery at a rate based on the slot's level and condition; the person's knocks in the match list become injuries. \n `Injury::apply_match_effects(game, fixture)`, from close_day_match (`close_day_match`) and from the simulated statistics (0x84be20), for every match: for both sides of the match (`match_record::SIDE_SIZE` bytes from `match_record::ROW_MINUTE_OFF`), the 20 slots of 0x49 bytes with a person (id at −0x30, `staff_of_match_slot`). The rate: the level (0x5a in the first eleven with the match flag `no_statistics()`; otherwise the slot's (`slot_rhythm_level`), minus +2 for the substitutes, which with 0xff gives 0) plus (10000 − condition +6) / 100, in 32 bits (the level enters only in the low 16). A game without the flag `home_side_mark()`: half (16 bits). With it: above 33 + random(3) years (`staff::AGE`), × 1.25 (`rdata::F64_1_25`, _ftol); otherwise below 23 − random(5), double. Before the start of the game (`G_GAME_START_DATE` after today, `exe::date_operator_3e`): 0. The recovery (`exe::injury_set_match_condition`) with the condition and the rate. With the knock (−0x11) and the match knock list (`injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST`): each knock of the person (type 7 only with player sheet `player_sheet::GOALKEEPER` of 15 or more) has the severity by +5 (above 95: 2; above 66: 1; above 51: 0; otherwise the previous knock's) and the injury type (`exe::injury_choose_injury_type`); a valid type: end of the current injury (`exe::injury_end_player_injury`) and the new injury (`exe::injury_add_injury` with the game, or 0 for game −2).

Returns the match knock list (`injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST`) item with the person's id, or 0. \n `Injury::find_match_injury(person)`: the item of the match knock list (`injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST`; cursor restarts from the head, `set_cursor(head())`, `exe::llist_get_next`) with the person's id, or 0 (also with no list). Used by the staff screens (0x870650, 0x885820).
1 if the person's current injury (`exe::injury_get_player_injury` on `G_INJURY`) is a holiday (type 0x51)

Ends the person's current injury: the history (except holidays), the return news at a human club (when asked), entry type 0xff and the record's `physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` set to −1. \n `Injury::end_player_injury(person, news)`, from the day's fitness (`update_player_fitness`, with news), from the match knocks (`apply_match_effects`, without) and from the fitness restart (`injury_reset_player`, without): with a current injury (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` of the record, index into the 0x30-byte table at `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRIES`; −1 none): except holidays (type 0x51), the history (`injury_fields::INJURY_HISTORY`, `exe::file_llist_add_node` with `physical_record::HISTORY_FIRST` and `physical_record::HISTORY_LAST` of the record); with `news` and the person's club (`club_job()`) human (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), the return news (`exe::injury_post_recovery_news` with 1 and the type). The type becomes 0xff and `physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` −1. Without a person: the error box (line 0xc87).

Stores an illness outbreak (date, type, club, fixture) if it takes hold (type 4 never; type 3 with 1 in 15, the others with 3 in 4; outside national teams) and re-sorts the array by date. \n `Injury::add_illness_outbreak(data, kind, club_i, fixture)`: the type is the low byte; if the outbreak takes hold (`outbreak_takes_hold`), the vector (`injury_fields::OUTBREAKS`) grows by 30 when full (`injury_fields::OUTBREAK_CAPACITY`; `exe::crt_realloc`, or `exe::crt_malloc` with no vector; out of memory, the "Error" box for line 0xd01 and nothing), the outbreak is written at the end (date through `exe::date_operator_3d`) and the vector is re-sorted by date (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_call_up_records_by_date`).

Spreads the illness outbreaks up to the first one after today: one older than five days is removed; the others make random squad players of the club ill. \n `Injury::spread_illness_outbreaks()`; SEH frame without destructor. It walks the outbreaks (`injury_fields::OUTBREAKS`, sorted by date) up to the first one after today. One older than five days (`five_days_ago`, `exe::date_sub_days`) is marked to leave; the others spread: type 3 only on the day itself, with 1 to 4 ill (random of 4, +1); the others 0 to 2 (random of 3). Outside national teams (`injury_is_national_team`), up to 20 tries: one of the 50 squad slots (random of 50, `club::SQUAD`), a player (id below `G_STAFF_COUNT`) without that illness (`last_injury_type()` of the 31-byte record at [this]) becomes ill (`exe::injury_add_injury`: the type in the low byte of the outbreak's offset dword, as in the original; the outbreak's fixture, `illness_outbreak::CLUB_ID`). At the end, those leaving go from the front of the vector (the others move down) and the count (`injury_fields::OUTBREAK_COUNT`) drops.

Tells whether the person is in the close season: 1 without a person; 1 when the club (without the `club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` mark) is out of its nation's season with less than 40 days to go and there is no future national call-up; otherwise 0. \n `injury_player_in_close_season(person)` (stdcall, ret 4; SEH frame without destructor): without a person, 1. With a national team (`national_job()`), its date (`exe::nationalteams_get_squad_slot_record` on `G_NATIONAL_TEAMS`, the national team's nation `nation()`, the class from `exe::national_teams_get_squad_slot` by bit 3 of `playing_squad()`) after today counts as called up. Without a club (`club_job()`), called up, or a club with `continental_comp_id()` ≠ −1: 0. Otherwise, out of the season of the club's nation (`exe::key_nation_club_in_season` with the two dates) and with less than 40 days to go (`exe::date_days_since` from today to the second date, 16 bits unsigned): 1; otherwise 0.

Sets each squad player's initial fitness from the club's pre-season days; non-players leave the squad slot. \n `Injury::init_squad_fitness()`; SEH frame without destructor. For each club (except national teams, `injury_club_count_without_nations`), the pre-season days (`preseason_days`; 0 in season, up to 40); each of the 50 slots (`club::SQUAD`) with a person whose id is below `G_STAFF_COUNT`: a player (`.player()`): v = days − (player's `natural_fitness()`)/2 − (person's `professionalism()`)/4 (signed, truncated), between 1 and 40, and the fitness (+8 of the 31-byte record at [this]) = 10000 − 75 × v; anyone who is not a player leaves the slot (0), and if their club (`club_job()`) is this one: job (`job_for_club()`, `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`) 0xb becomes clubless and 8 (`job_kind::COACH`), 0xf becomes 8, 0xd becomes 6.

Allocates every person's 31-byte injury record fully fit; players may get a recurring injury (1 in 10) or start injured (1 in 100); the totals go to 0xde1f64. \n `Injury::init_records()`: [this] = 31 bytes per person of `G_STAFF_COUNT` (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the "Error" box for line 0x7d0 and nothing). Each record: today's date (`exe::date_operator_3d`), form and condition 10000 (+8, `physical_record::CONDITION`), wear 0 (`physical_record::FATIGUE`), no injury (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` −1), no recurring injury (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` 0xff), history −1 (`physical_record::HISTORY_FIRST`, `physical_record::HISTORY_LAST`), `physical_record::LAST_INJURY_TYPE` 0xff, `physical_record::PRONENESS` 50. A player (`staff::PLAYER`): the type drawn from 82 with weight (+8 of the 13-byte table at 0x9e7ad8) and 1 in 10 becomes recurring; 1 in 100 starts injured: category drawn from 12, type through `exe::injury_choose_injury_type` (severity −1) and the new injury `exe::injury_add_injury`. At the end the two totals in 0xde1f64 ("%d players with ...").

with 1 in 20, a recurring-capable injury becomes recurring in the record (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` type, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0); among the recurring records, the best score (roll 0x65 − 5 × level − proneness, stops at 95): a player at a big club (reputation > 4250) without a human and 1 in 3 gets a new injury 0x4d/0x4e/0x4f (`exe::injury_add_injury`); otherwise his mark is cleared; turned off (DESLIGADAS) from 2026-10-29 to 2026-10-31, when the test criterion changed and the list was emptied (the detour, even passing through, changes the stack residue a later original reads: the career left be54a138); the copy stays in the code and does not run

Clears the last entry of the person's injury history (`physical_record::HISTORY_LAST` of the 31-byte record = −1, through `exe::file_llist_reset_last_offset`). \n `Injury::reset_player_history(person)`: the person's injury history (31-byte record of the id at [this]) loses its last entry (`exe::file_llist_reset_last_offset` on `injury_fields::INJURY_HISTORY`: `physical_record::HISTORY_LAST` = −1). Returns what `exe::file_llist_reset_last_offset` returns. Null person: as in the original (fatal box).

Resets a person's injury state: removes their items from the match knock list, ends the injury, rewinds the history and restarts the 31-byte record; bit 0 of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record is cleared. \n `Injury::reset_player(id)`: removes from list `injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST` (from the start: `set_cursor(head())`) each item with the id (`exe::llist_remove`); with an injury (`current_injury()` ≠ −1), ends it (`exe::injury_end_player_injury`, no news); restarts the history (`exe::injury_reset_player_history`); the 31-byte record restarts: today's date (`exe::date_operator_3d` of `G_CURRENT_DATE`), condition and form 10000 (+8, `set_condition`), wear 0 (`set_fatigue`), no injury (`set_current_injury(-1)`), no recurring injury (`set_recurring_type(0xff)`), history −1 (`set_history_first`, `set_history_last`), `set_last_injury_type(0xff)`. Bit 0 of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) is cleared. Returns the address of that byte.

Applies a recovery day to person `p`'s 31-byte record (below −1000 in x87 with −0.0035 and 2.5; otherwise the rate or a random draw). \n In the 31-byte record (from [t]): `physical_record::CONDITION` receives `mark` (`set_condition`); the word `physical_record::FATIGUE`, below −1000, rises by trunc((v × −0.0035 (`rdata::F64_NEG_0_0035`) − 2.5 (`rdata::F64_2_5`)) × `ritmo`); otherwise, below 1200 − (player sheet `player_sheet::WORK_RATE` + player sheet `player_sheet::STAMINA` + person `staff::PROFESSIONALISM`, 16 bits), it rises by `ritmo`; otherwise, below 1250, it rises by random(`ritmo`) + 1 (`exe::utils_random`). Null person or id outside `G_STAFF_COUNT`: nothing.
