Returns the player's condition: fitness × match condition / 10,000 (minimum 100, maximum 9000 while recovering), or as a percentage (maximum 100). \n `Injury::get_condition(player, in_percent)`: the player's condition: `condition()` (+0xa) × +8 / 10,000 from the id's 31-byte record [this], at least 100 and at most 9000 while he is recovering (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 1); as a percentage (× `rdata::F32_0_009999999776` + `rdata::F64_0_5`, _ftol), at most 100. A person outside the players (`G_STAFF_COUNT`): 100 or 10,000. Null player: 0.

Updates the day's fitness (`exe::injury_update_player_fitness`) and returns the match condition (out of 10000, or as a percentage). \n `Injury::get_match_condition(player, in_percent)`: without a player, 0; an id outside the persons (`G_STAFF_COUNT`): 10000 (100 as a percentage); otherwise it updates the day's fitness (`exe::injury_update_player_fitness`, once a day) and returns the condition (31-byte record at [this], +0xa), as a percentage × 0.01f (`rdata::F32_0_009999999776`) truncated. Only ax is the return value.

Updates a person's fitness once a day: the days since the last update become free, recovery, stopped (injury) or holiday days, which raise or lower fitness (+8) and match condition (`physical_record::CONDITION`); stores today's date. \n `Injury::update_player_fitness(person)`; SEH frame only for the local statics. Once a day (if date +0 of the person's 31-byte record at [this] is already today: nothing), called from the match condition (`get_match_condition`), the injury state (`get_player_injury_status`), the injuries day (`injury_daily_update`) and the return news (`post_due_recovery_news`): every person who plays, every day someone asks. T = days since the last update (`days_since`). Injured (`current_injury()` in the 0x30-byte table at `injury_fields::INJURY_ENTRIES`): by the days since the start (`injury_entry::DATE`) against `training_return_days()` and `days_out()`, the stopped days (loss), recovery days or free days, with the end of the injury (`end_injury`) when it passes `days_out()`. Not injured: free days, except with the national team with a future date (`exe::national_teams_get_squad_slot`/`exe::nationalteams_get_squad_slot_record`) or at a club out of season (`exe::key_nation_club_in_season`, cached in `G_FITNESS_UPDATE_CACHED_CLUB`/`G_FITNESS_UPDATE_CACHED_SEASON_FLAG` with the dates `G_FITNESS_UPDATE_SEASON_START_DATE`/`G_FITNESS_UPDATE_SEASON_END_DATE`): holidays (byte `staff_state::INJURY_COUNTER` of the 79-byte record rises when random(`professionalism()` / 3 + 2) is zero, up to 50) and the pre-season return (15 days, or the middle of a random(2) with form × condition below 80%). The fitness (+8): recovery of 1000 − 12 × (`proneness()` − natural (`natural_fitness()` of the player sheet), 0..100) per free day, loss of 66 per stopped day, capped by natural fitness, stretches above 7000/9000/9850 shrunk (0x96af30, 0x96bad0, 0x968968, 0x968918, 0x967880), and −55 per holiday day; the match condition (`condition()`) rises 500 × free days and 250 × recovery days times the tiredness factor (`fatigue()`). \n Writes both and today's date.

Applies the day's wear to word +0xc of person `id`'s 31-byte record (age, draws of 25 and 13, goalkeeper cap). \n From [t]: below −1000 it goes down 1; under 19 years old (`age()` of the person in `G_STAFF_TABLE`) and negative, it is zeroed; otherwise, from −500 up and with age ≥ random(25) (`exe::utils_random`), it goes down 13, and in the other cases it goes down random(13); a goalkeeper (player sheet position `goalkeeper()` = 20) stays up to 1050. Id outside `G_STAFF_COUNT`: nothing.

Returns the player's recurring injury type, or 0xff when he has none or is not a player. \n `Injury::get_recurring_injury_type(person)`, from the news (0x77bc80), the physio's assessment (0x7a2650) and the screens: the type of the recurring injury (+0x12 of the person's 31-byte fitness record, at [this]); null person, id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on, or no player sheet (`.player()`): 0xff. The callers only read al.

Rebuilds a retired person from the regen queue as a young player: player record, nation, names, languages, age and ability, reputations, birth date, personality attributes and, by chance, a club. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::regenerate_as_youth_player(p)`, from the regen queue (`process_regen_queue`) for every young regen. A person not retired (bits 0x30 of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record) or with a club (`club_job()`): it only clears the bits. Otherwise: leaves the national team (`national_teams_remove_player`), takes the front record of the player record pool (`player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL`, 16-byte entries: record, nation `regen_pool_item::NATION_ID`, second nation `regen_pool_item::SECOND_NATION_ID`; `exe::player_regen_remove_player_data_from_pool`), becomes a player (`set_classification(2)`, `set_player` the record) and the 79-byte record gets the regen mark (`staff_state_status_flags::REGEN_MARK`) and loses the others; the person's lists and histories are cleared (fog, statistics, history, suspensions, injuries, dispute, discipline, fitness, contracts); the record's nation (or, if its `nation::NUMBER_STAFF` is below 100, with 1/4, any one with `number_staff()` below 100), the second nation (Spain `KEY_NATION_SPAIN` with 1/100 keeps the previous one; another one other than the Basque Country `KEY_NATION_PAYS_BASQUE` with 2/3 none), the nation's names (`exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_get_empty_common_name`), the languages (all removed, `exe::playerstats_remove_language`; the nation's by weight, `exe::player_stats_get_native_language_points`, level (weight − (20 − `adaptability()`) × 10) / 75 up to 10, `exe::playerstats_add_language`), the joining date today, `job_for_club()`/`job_for_nation()` = 11 (`job_kind::PLAYER`). The age and ability: a small nation (`number_staff()` below 350, `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED` zero) by the `number_staff()` (23..27 or 17..23 years) and by the PA; otherwise by the record's position and the age by random(10000) (15..18 rare, 16..18, 17..20, 21..26). The reputations (`home_reputation()`, `current_reputation()`, `world_reputation()`), the ability caps, the birth year and day, the age (`exe::database_get_staff_age`), the personality attributes (`player_sheet::ACCELERATION`, `player_sheet::PLAYER_PACE`, `player_sheet::AGILITY`, `player_sheet::JUMPING`, `player_sheet::NATURAL_FITNESS`, `player_sheet::WORK_RATE`, `player_sheet::STAMINA`, `player_sheet::STRENGTH`, `player_sheet::ANTICIPATION`, `player_sheet::DECISIONS`, `player_sheet::IMPORTANT_MATCHES`, `player_sheet::LEADERSHIP`, `player_sheet::CONSISTENCY`) by age; under 19 and a nation with `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED`, with 3/4, the best club (`exe::player_regen_pick_best_club_for_player`) and the contract (`FN_PLAYER_REGEN_SIGN_FOR_CLUB`, news `exe::player_regen_post_youth_promotion_news` at a human club and the chairman (`club::CHAIRMAN`) may like him, `exe::staff_add_favoured_staff`); otherwise, by chance, a club of the nation (`exe::player_regen_pick_club_from_nation_list`). Without a club and under 20, the reputations up to 1250 and `world_reputation()` = 1. At the end, the attributes normalised (`exe::staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_player_attributes`).

Finds the person of a player_setup.cfg line by the three names: among all persons or, with the club name, in its squad (when asked) and its manager. \n `player_setup_find_staff(first, common, second, club, in_squad)` (cdecl). Without `club` (null or empty): the first of the `G_STAFF_COUNT` persons (`G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e bytes) whose non-empty names match (each name checked only if both the text and the person's name exist). With `club`: the club with that name (`exe::club_get_english_name`, 51 characters); not found, 0. With `in_squad` 1: the first of the 50 squad slots (`club::SQUAD`) whose names match; otherwise (or none in the squad), the club's manager (`club::MANAGER`) if the names match; otherwise 0.

Processes the day's pending retirements: drops some, retires the others (news, contract, national team, squad), possibly turns the player into a coach, stores the record in the regen pool or queues the regen slot, and announces the future ones. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::process_retirements()`, every day from the day loop; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. The local slot for the regen (id and the default date `exe::date_date_54a110`, which leaves leap flag 1 in it); it sorts the pending retirements (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT` of 26 bytes: +0 the person, `retirement_entry::CLUB_ID` the club or −1, `retirement_entry::ANNOUNCE_DATE`/`retirement_entry::ANNOUNCE_YEAR` the announcement day and year, `retirement_entry::RETIRE_DATE`/`retirement_entry::RETIRE_YEAR` those of the retirement, `retirement_entry::REASON` the reason, `retirement_entry::ANNOUNCED` announced) with `player_regen_compare_retirements` and walks through them (the pointer only advances on an announcement: `remove_retirement` pulls the following ones). Due (the date has passed; `process_due_retirement`): a young player (up to 29) with a club or flag, except reason 8, gives up; with a contract record (`contract_record`) or under offer (`is_player_under_offer`), gives up (flags & 0xcf); one who moved club less than 210 days ago, up to 37 years old, with a contract, off the list and without +0x45, stays; otherwise the news (`player_regen_post_retirement_news`), the offers (`remove_pending_offers_for_staff`), the contract, the national team (`national_teams_remove_player`), the watch lists, the squad (`retire_from_playing_staff`), the absences (`clear_awol`, `clear_missed_training`) and the dispute (`remove_dispute`); the player may become a coach (attributes from reputation and record); with a player record and a non-player record, the record goes to the pool (`add_player_data_to_pool`) and the new contract (0x85e960); otherwise the regen slot (`queue_staff_for_regen`) and, with a non-player record, he leaves the jobs (`player_regen_retire_from_non_playing_staff`) or is rebuilt as a non-player (`exe::player_regen_regenerate_as_non_player`). Not due: with the announcement date passed and not announced, the announcement news (`exe::player_regen_post_retirement_announcement_news`, if flags & 0x30 are not 0x10), the announced flag and flags 0x10 (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_ANNOUNCED`); otherwise it stops. At the end it sorts the regen slots (`player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE`, `player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE_COUNT` of 12 bytes) with `player_regen_compare_queue_entries`.

Posts news item 0xbba about the retirement to the managers (all, the country, the division, the club or the interested clubs, by fame) and pays the club insurance when injury retires a valuable player. \n `player_regen_post_retirement_news(p, reason, announced)` (stdcall, ret 0xc; `process_retirements` puts this in ecx, unused; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path). No person, a player with job 8 or 5 (`job_for_club()`), no club, or a club without a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`): nothing. News 0xbba (local): 0..3 the person (id and the `names::ID` of `staff::FIRST_NAME`/`staff::SECOND_NAME`/`staff::COMMON_NAME`), 4 the reason, 5 announced, 6 the club (−1 if none), 7 the nation (`nation()`) with the national team caps (`int_apps()`) or −1, 8 the job (0xf becomes 8, 0xd becomes 6), 9 the reputation, 0xa `job_for_nation()`, 0xb player record and non-player record, 0xc the age, 0xd the non-player record, 0xe the player record. The interested clubs (`exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` on `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER` with 0xa, up to 30, only for a player). A major nation (`league_standard()` above 8) and a star (`world_reputation()` of the player record above 8500, or a manager of job 5 with non-player `world_reputation()` above 8750): to everyone (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); a lesser star (`world_reputation()` above 7500, or job 5 with non-player `current_reputation()` above 7250): to the managers of the nation and of the club's nation (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`); a manager of job 5 at a club with a division: to those of the division (`exe::news_send_to_division_managers`); a non-player: to the club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); a player: to the interested clubs. Reason 8 (injury) with `current_reputation()` of the player record above 4250 and a contract club (`contract_of_uncached`, cached in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`): the insurance (`exe::news_post_insurance_payout` with `value()`).

Posts news item 0xbce about a youth player joining the club, with the assistant manager's or a coach's verdict on his ability. \n `player_regen_post_youth_promotion_news(j, c)` (stdcall, ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path), from the young regen (`regenerate_as_youth_player`). No player or club: nothing. News 0xbce (local): 0..3 the player (id and the `names::ID` of `staff::FIRST_NAME`/`staff::SECOND_NAME`/`staff::COMMON_NAME`), 4 the club id, 5 the age, 6 the club's strength (`training()`) above 15. The assistant manager (`assistant_manager()`) and the five coaches (`coaches()`) give their opinion until the first one who gives a verdict: the perceived reputation = random(2500) + club reputation (`reputation()`) / 2 + strength × 12.5 (`rdata::F64_12_5`, truncated); the two perceived abilities (`exe::match_man_judge_player_ability` with 2 and with 1) against reputation / 50 + 75 (verdict 2) and reputation / 100 + 50 (1). With a verdict: 7 assistant?, 8..0xb who (id and names), 0xc and 0xd the verdicts; otherwise −1. Delivered at the club's scope (`exe::news_send_by_scope`).

Signs the regen for a club: the first free squad slot, the value, the contract end, the contract and the default wage; returns 1 (0 without a slot). \n `player_regen_sign_for_club(person, club)` (stdcall, ret 8; SEH frame only for the local dates), from PLAYER_REGEN::regenerate_as_youth_player (`regenerate_as_youth_player`) for every young regen: in the first free slot of the 50 in the squad (`first_free_squad_slot`, `set_squad`; no slot, 0) the person, her club (`set_club_job`) and `set_wage(0)`; the value (`set_value`) through `exe::contract_manager_calc_player_value` (club, 1, −1, 0), the squad (`exe::staff_set_squad_flags` with 1), one time in four (random(4) = 0, `exe::utils_random`) `exe::staff_add_favoured_club` (person, club, 0); a club with `professional_status()` = 3 (`professional_status::AMATEUR`): value at most 5000. The contract end (`staff::DATE_EXPIRES_CLUB`): under 19 (`age()`), today's year + 2; otherwise + random(6) + 1; in the month of the club's season end (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_SEASON_END_MONTH`) and on day random(28) + 1 (`exe::date_date_549f70`). The contract (`exe::contract_manager_add_staff_contract` with the value); a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1): for the reserves (`exe::contract_manager_move_to_reserves`) and the contract bits `contract::SQUAD_STATUS` (0x60 high) and `contract::CONTRACT_TYPE` (1 low). With a contract: the default wage (`exe::staff_contract_set_default_wage`), `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER` = 0 and, outside the human club, the end (`contract::CONTRACT_EXPIRES_YEAR`) at most today's year + 5 (with day `contract::CONTRACT_EXPIRES` = 0). At the end the squad numbers (`G_SQUAD_MANAGER`, `exe::squad_manager_club_uses_squad_numbers` and `exe::squad_manager_allocate_squad_number`). Returns 1.

Replaces the person's pending retirement with a new one through injury (reason 8), random(days / 2) + 1 days ahead. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::schedule_injury_retirement(person, days)`, from the new injury (`add_injury`) that ends the career; SEH frame only for the local dates. It removes the person's pending retirement (the first with her id in the 26-byte table `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, count `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT`; `exe::player_regen_remove_retirement`) and adds (`exe::player_regen_add_retirement`) the new one: id, club id (`club_job()`, or −1), today's date + random(days / 2) + 1 (`exe::utils_random`, `exe::date_add_days`) at +8 and again at +0x10, reason 8 (+0x18) and 0 (+0x19).

Builds news 0xbbb (id, names, reason, contract club, age) and sends it to the managers of the interested clubs. \n `player_regen_post_retirement_announcement_news(person, reason)` (stdcall, ret 8; SEH frame without destructor), from PLAYER_REGEN::process_retirements (`process_retirements`): except for a player (`player()`) with job `job_for_club()` 8 or 5, news 0xbbb in a local (`exe::new_newsitem` with 0) with data 0 = id, 1 to 3 = the names (`names::ID` of +4, +8 and +0xc), 4 = reason, 5 = the id of the contract club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, cached in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`; club of the 0x245-byte record (`club_at`) by `club()`; a contract of type `contract_type()` & 0x3f = 5 or no club: −1) and 6 = the age (`age()`); it goes to the managers of up to 30 interested clubs (`G_TRANSFER_MANAGER`, `exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` with 10; `exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Appends to the pool of free player records the player record id of a person who stops playing, with the nation and second nation, growing the table by 250. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::add_player_data_to_pool(person, nation, second)`: appends to the free player pool (16 bytes at `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL`, count `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_CAPACITY`) the player record id (`player()`) of the person with index `person` (`staff::SIZE`-byte record in `G_STAFF_TABLE`) at +0, the nation at `regen_pool_item::NATION_ID` and the second nation at `regen_pool_item::SECOND_NATION_ID` (+0xc is left as it is). Count = capacity − 1: grows by 250 (realloc `crt_realloc`; out of memory, box 0xa0a and end, `regen_out_of_memory`). From process_retirements (`process_retirements`), when a player who also has a non-player record stops playing.

At a new game, decides whether a person with a club retires this season: non-players by the job age limit, players by the profile limit, the ability, the club's competition and the contract status; fills the output and the dates. \n `player_regen_check_initial_retirement(person, out)` (thiscall without reading this, ret 8): on a new game (from `build_initial_retirement_list`), does the person with a club (`club_job()`) retire this season? The contract (contract_with_current_club) and the status (contract_status). Without a player record (`player()`): without a manager record (`non_player()`) always; with it, when past the limit (non_player_age_limit); reason 0x20. A player: past the record's limit (player_age_limit), v = ⌊⌊1 − (age − limit) × 0.1 (`rdata::F64_0_1`)⌋ × ability (`current_reputation()`)⌋ (16 bits); over 45, reason 1. A club without a competition (`division()`; without a club, a nation without `league_selected()`): random(3) ≠ 0 retires, otherwise only a negative status with a club. Otherwise: v ≥ 5000 or `current_ability()` > 80, no; `current_ability()` < 10 or v < 1500, yes; with a club, only a negative status; without a club, reason 2 with random(25 × `stamina()`) = 0. Whoever retires: the output (fill_retirement_entry: id, club, reason) and the announcement and retirement dates (set_retirement_dates, by the key nation; without a valid key nation, tomorrow); returns 1.

In the search for new retirements, decides whether the person retires: like the initial check, with the limit adjusted by contract and wage, unemployment, contract end and potential; without a key nation, dates drawn near today. \n `player_regen_check_retirement(person, out)` (thiscall without reading this, ret 8), from the search for new retirements (`find_new_retirements`). Without a player record: as in `player_regen_check_initial_retirement` (reason 0x20). A player above the record's limit: over 33, the limit drops 1 without a contract with the club, or with `grievances()` in the contract and `attacker()`/`attacking_midfielder()` of the record = 20, or the high nibble of `squad_status()` = 7; with a club and a contract with wage (`wage()`) above 750 × (`loyalty()` + 10) until after this year (`contract_expires_year()`), it drops 1 (and 1 more with `loyalty()` < 6). v = ⌊(1 − (age − limit) × 0.075 (`rdata::F64_0_075`)) × ability (`current_reputation()`)⌋ (16 bits). Reason 1: over 45; over 34 without a club and unemployed for more than 65 days (since `date_joined_club()`, `FN_DATE_DAYS_SINCE`); 3 years above the limit, over 31 and the contract's `unhappy_flag()` > 5; 4 above: without a club; or a contract less than 300 days from its end (`exe::staff_contract_days_to_end_date`), status below 50 and manager (`non_player()`) or `ambition()` > random(20) with potential × 0.85 (`rdata::F64_0_85`) above the current ability (`potential_ability()` and `current_ability()`). Then v > 5500, no. A club in a competition not running in the game (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`[id] = 0, or without `division()`; without a club, a nation without `league_selected()`): random(3) = 0 retires; with a club and a negative status too; otherwise only with v < 3500. Otherwise as in `player_regen_check_initial_retirement` (`current_ability()` > 100 no; `current_ability()` < 10 or v < 1500 yes; with a club only a negative status; without a club reason 2 with random(25 × `stamina()`) = 0). Whoever retires: the output and the dates (without a valid key nation, set_dates_no_key_nation, near today); returns 1.

At a new game, tests every eligible person (`exe::player_regen_check_initial_retirement`), adds those who retire to the list and sorts it. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::build_initial_retirement_list`; SEH only for the local dates, with an empty destructor. On a new game, each person (0x6e bytes in `G_STAFF_TABLE`, up to `G_STAFF_COUNT`, re-read at each step) with id below `G_STAFF_COUNT` − 16, without bits 0x30 (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`) of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) and without a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) with `leaving_on_bosman()` is tested (`exe::player_regen_check_initial_retirement`); whoever retires goes into the list (`exe::player_regen_add_retirement`). At the end the qsort of the list (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, count `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT`, 26 bytes, `player_regen_compare_retirements`).

Tests every eligible person for retirement by age (`exe::player_regen_check_retirement`) or unemployment (`exe::player_regen_check_unemployed_retirement`), adds those who retire and sorts the list. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::find_new_retirements` (on the days of `is_player_regen_day`); SEH only for the local dates, with an empty destructor. Each person (0x6e bytes in `G_STAFF_TABLE`, up to the end computed with the count `G_STAFF_COUNT` at the start). Excluded: under 30 years old (`staff::AGE`) at a club of a competition that runs in the game (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`[id] of the competition `club::DIVISION`); id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` − 16 on (re-read at each step); bits 0x30 (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`) of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`); those already in the list (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, 26 bytes, count `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT`); a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) with `contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN`. The others: retirement by age (`exe::player_regen_check_retirement`) or, failing that, the unemployed one (`exe::player_regen_check_unemployed_retirement`); whoever retires goes into the list (`exe::player_regen_add_retirement`). At the end the qsort of the list (`player_regen_compare_retirements`).

Scores a person as the donor of non-player data: −10000 when under 31 or flagged; otherwise random draws and attribute terms. \n `player_regen_score_non_player_candidate(person)` (stdcall, ret 4): the person's score as donor of the non-player data (from `player_regen_pick_staff_for_non_player_data`, for each non-player person). −10000 with `non_player()`, with bits 0x30 (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`) of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) or under 31 (`age()`). Otherwise random 150 × (age − 31); with a club (`club_job()`) with reputation (`reputation()`) and a player record (`player()`), + 250 × (current ability `current_reputation()` ÷ reputation); with a player record, + random(⌊(`leadership()` ÷ 2)³⌋) (pow `game_pow` and _ftol), +100 with `world_reputation()` > 7500 and +50 with `current_reputation()` > 7500; the attributes + 5 × (3 × (`temperament()` + `pressure()`) + 2 × (`loyalty()` + `determination()`) + `adaptability()`) + ⌊`professionalism()`²⌋ + ⌊`ambition()`²⌋. With a club: a random draw of the score (+75 if the club has no `manager()`); without a club: + (`int_apps()`)², and the score doubles if the player's `world_reputation()` exceeds a random(10000) (it reads the player record without checking, as the original does). Hot (every person on each call): no counter.

Removes the player from his club and national team and changes the player job to the staff job; without a kept job, clears the club and the national team. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::retire_from_playing_staff(p)` (stdcall, ret 4): removes `p` from the club (`club_job()`) and the national team (`national_job()`) (`remove_from_team`: the tactics and the 50 slots) and changes the player job to the staff one (tables 0x7aae60 and 0x7aae90): by the club job (`job_for_club()`, signed byte; outside 0..16 the default applies) 12 → 5 (`job_kind::MANAGER`), 13 → 6 (`job_kind::ASSISTANT_MANAGER`), 15 → 8 (`job_kind::COACH`) (stays at the club), 0 and 16 (warning "already retired", `format_already_retired`) nothing, 1 to 10 the routine ends there, the others 0x10 (retired, `job_kind::RETIRED_PLAYER`). Then by the national team job (`job_for_nation()`) in the same way, but 12/13/15 write into `job_for_club()` (`set_job_for_club`; the original writes there, not into `job_for_nation()`) and the default writes 0x10 into `job_for_nation()`. With no job kept, the club (`set_club_job`) and the national team (`set_national_job`) are zeroed. No SEH, no random draw.

Picks the best-scored club (`exe::player_regen_score_club_for_player`) among those where the youngster is not a foreigner, that are not a B team, that may approach him and with a squad under 50. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::pick_best_club_for_player(player)`: among the clubs (`G_CLUB_TABLE`, 0x245 bytes; the first `G_CLUB_COUNT` − 2 × `G_NATION_COUNT`, re-read on every loop) where the player is not a foreigner (`FN_DATABASE_IS_STAFF_FOREIGN` with the nation `club::NATION` and 1), that are not the B team of a pair (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 1, finding the partner with 0), not vetoed (`is_basque_restricted`), that may approach him (`can_club_bid`) and with a squad (`exe::database_count_club_squad`) under 50, the one with the highest score (`exe::player_regen_score_club_for_player`, random; compared in 16 bits, starting from −25000). None: 0. No SEH; the partner local is only read when `exe::club_get_linked_b_team` finds it (and writes it).

Picks, from the club list of the youngster's nation, the club with the highest random draw of the score by reputation against ability, among those that may approach him and with a squad under 50. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::pick_club_from_nation_list(player)`: walks the club list of the youngster's nation (`player_regen_youth_list_nation`, some nations mapped to [0x9cf2e4]; word +0 is the count, the cursor restarts from the head (`set_cursor(head())`), the iterator `exe::llist_get_next` returns the id) and, among the clubs not vetoed (`is_basque_restricted`), that may approach him (`can_club_bid`) and with a squad (`exe::database_count_club_squad`) under 50, keeps the one with the highest random draw (`exe::utils_random`) of the score (5000 + reputation `reputation()` minus its distances to the ability of the player record `player()`: `current_reputation()`, `potential_ability()` × 50 and `current_ability()` × 50, in 16 bits), compared in 16 bits starting from −25000. No list or an empty list: 0. A list that ends before the count: the "Error" box (line 0x19e9) and 0. No SEH.

Appends (id, nation, second nation) to the 16-byte spare non-player record list (`player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS`); grows by 250 when the player pool (`player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_COUNT`/`player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_CAPACITY`) is full, as in the original. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::add_spare_non_player_record(id, nation, second)`: appends (id +0, nation `regen_pool_item::NATION_ID`, second nation `regen_pool_item::SECOND_NATION_ID`) to the 16-byte list of spare non-player records (`player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS`, count `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_CAPACITY`; taken out by `remove_spare_non_player_record`). The original decides to grow by the free player pool (count `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_COUNT` = capacity `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_CAPACITY` − 1), not by this list: kept faithfully. Grows by 250 (realloc `crt_realloc`; out of memory, box 0x9c4 and end, `regen_out_of_memory`).

Appends the record fields to the 26-byte pending retirement table (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`), growing by 250. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::add_retirement(record)`: appends to the 26-byte table of pending retirements (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, count `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_CAPACITY`) the record's fields +0, `club_id()` (dwords), `retirement_entry::REASON` (byte), +8, +0xa, +0x10, +0x12 (words) and `retirement_entry::ANNOUNCED` (byte), in that order (+0xc..+0x10 and +0x14..+0x18 are left as they are). Count = capacity − 1: grows by 250 (realloc `crt_realloc`; out of memory, box 0xa53 and end, `regen_out_of_memory`).

Puts the person into the regen queue (`player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE`) with the dates; the non-player data goes into the spare list (`player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS`, random nation if none) and the player data into the free pool (`player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL`). \n `PLAYER_REGEN::queue_staff_for_regen(entry)`: the person with id +0 of the entry (0x6e-byte record in `G_STAFF_TABLE`) enters the regen queue (12 bytes at `player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE`, count `player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE_CAPACITY`: id +0, words +4 and +6 of the entry into `regen_queue_entry::REGEN_DATE` and `regen_queue_entry::REGEN_YEAR`). With non-player data (`non_player()`): in the 16-byte list `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS` (count `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_CAPACITY`) their id +0, the nation (`nation()`; without a nation, a random draw `exe::utils_random` among the `G_NATION_COUNT`) +4 and the person's id `regen_pool_item::STAFF_ID`. With player data (`player()`): in the free player pool `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL` (count `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_COUNT`, capacity `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_CAPACITY`) their id +0, the nation's +4 (without checking for null, as in the original) and the person's `regen_pool_item::STAFF_ID`. Each list grows by 250 when count = capacity − 1 (realloc `crt_realloc`; boxes 0xaac, 0xac5, 0xae9 and end, `regen_out_of_memory`; in the third the original checks the count, not the pointer: kept faithfully). Id outside 0..=`G_STAFF_COUNT`: as in the original (box 0xa9d).

Removes a pending retirement: finds it (26 bytes), pulls the next ones up (`exe::retire_record_assign`), blanks the last one (person −1) and lowers the count. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::remove_retirement(key)`: searches (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `player_regen_compare_retirements`) for the pending retirement in the vector (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT` records of 26 bytes); found: pulls the following ones up one place (`exe::retire_record_assign`, the record copy), the last one gets person −1 and `retirement_entry::REASON` (`set_reason(0)`), +8, +0xa, +0x10, +0x12 zeroed, and the count goes down. Without re-sorting.

Decides whether an unemployed person retires: a weak manager without a club, a player unemployed for over a year, or anyone with no record; fills the entry (reason 0x10, the game date) and returns 1. \n `player_regen_check_unemployed_retirement(person, out)` (stdcall, ret 8): whoever is on the shortlist (`player_regen_is_on_shortlist`) does not retire. With a manager record (`non_player()`): without a club (`club_job()`) and without `national_job()`, with `current_reputation()` of the record below 50 and random(5) = 0. Without it, with a player record (`player()`): off the list (checked again), without a club and without `national_job()`, unemployed for more than 365 days (365 × (year − year of `date_joined_club_year()`) − day of `date_joined_club()` + day) and random(the player's rating `player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`) < 750. With neither record: always. Retires: the output (26 bytes) receives the person, reason 0x10 (`set_reason`), `set_announced(0)`, the club (`set_club_id`, −1 if none) and the game date at +8 and +0x10; returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Picks the non-player with the highest positive score (`exe::player_regen_score_non_player_candidate`) of the nation; with none, of any nation; otherwise 0. \n `player_regen_pick_staff_for_non_player_data(nation)`: among the non-player persons (`G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e bytes, `G_STAFF_COUNT` − 16 of them, count re-read on every loop), the one with the highest positive score from `exe::player_regen_score_non_player_candidate` (random; the incoming ecx goes along, as in the original) of nation `nation` (`staff::NATION`+0 = nation; initial score −1000); with none, the one with the highest positive score of any nation (initial −15000); otherwise 0.

Returns the random score of how well the club suits the youth player: reputation against ability, youth facilities, human control and nation. \n The score of `club` for the young `player` (random(score), `exe::utils_random`): 5000 + reputation (`reputation()`) minus its distances to the ability (player record `player()`: `current_reputation()`, and `potential_ability()`, `current_ability()` × 50); with `potential_ability()` above random(20) + 100, the youth bonus (`training()`, 20 = guaranteed, otherwise random(`training()`) > random(20)); a club of an active competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`) with `potential_ability()` > 50: the human club state (`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE`) and the reputation against the squad (`squad`); the youth coach (`manager()` → `non_player()`) of a computer club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) or the human's bonus; the same nation (`nation()` of the player and of the club) and the Welsh clubs (Swansea, Cardiff, Wrexham) and Scotland (`KEY_NATION_SCOTLAND`). Only the low 16 bits of the score count.

Copies a pending retirement record: the person, the club, the two dates, the reason and the announced flag. \n Copies the pending retirement (0x1a bytes) from `source`: the person's id (+0) and the club's (`club_id()`), the dates at `retirement_entry::ANNOUNCE_DATE` and `retirement_entry::RETIRE_DATE` (`exe::date_operator_3d`, with the return value in a local), the reason (`reason()`) and the announced flag (`announced()`). Returns `this`.

Builds one club list per nation; each club with a division joins its nation's list, except national teams and the clubs at 0x9d00a4/0x9d00a8. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::build_nation_club_lists()`; SEH frame for the `new`. [this] = 14 bytes per nation of `G_NATION_COUNT` (`exe::crt_malloc`, no check), with a new list (`exe::crt_operator_new` of 0xe and `exe::new_llist`; out of memory, 0) per nation; each club of `G_CLUB_COUNT` goes (`exe::llist_add_tail`, the 4 bytes of the id) into its nation's list (`injury_youth_list_nation`: clubs with a division, a nation with +0x11c only with +0x80 up to 2, except national teams and the clubs at 0x9d00a4/0x9d00a8).

Processes the regen queue every day: due youth regens are created, and with more than 2 spare coach records, count − 2 of them are given to persons who lend the data. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::process_regen_queue()`, from the day loop (0x5cccd0), every day. The youth regen queue (`player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE`, 12 bytes: +0 id, `regen_queue_entry::REGEN_DATE` date; count `player_regen_fields::REGEN_QUEUE_COUNT`): from the front, while the first one's date is before today (`is_regen_entry_due`) and `player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL_COUNT` is not zero, the youth regen (`exe::player_regen_regenerate_as_youth_player`) of the person (id outside 0..`G_STAFF_COUNT`: box "Invalid staff_id for regen" and end), the following ones move up one place (`exe::regen_queue_entry_assign`) and the last gets id −1. Then, with more than 2 spare coach records (`player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS`, count `player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_COUNT`), for count − 2 of them: the person lending the data (`exe::player_regen_pick_staff_for_non_player_data` by the first one's nation +4) gets the spare's non-player record (`set_non_player`, `G_NON_PLAYER_TABLE` + 0x44 × id); a former player: the swap of `coaching()`/`coaching_gks()` of the rating 20, the normalisation (`exe::staff_normalise_non_player_attributes`), the job at the computer's club (`place_coach_at_ai_club`) and the three ratings (`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, +8, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION`) by the reputation (`current_reputation()`), +9 and `world_reputation()` of the player record (band above 7500, or random(`ambition()`) and the other two; pow and bands; `rebuilt_coach_rating`); a non-player: random(1500) and random(500). The spare leaves (`exe::player_regen_remove_spare_non_player_record`).

Returns 1 when the person's id is on the retirement list, otherwise 0. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::is_retirement_pending(person)`: 1 when the person's id (+0) is on the retirement list (`player_regen_fields::RETIREMENTS`, 0x1a-byte records, count `player_regen_fields::RETIREMENT_COUNT` signed), otherwise 0 (and 0 without a person). Used by MANAGER_MANAGER::is_staff_suitable_for_job 0x69fa4b: a non-player who is about to retire is not suitable as a manager.

Copies the first spare non-player record entry (id, nation, second nation) to the outputs and removes it from the list. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::take_spare_non_player_record(&id, &nation, &second)`, from contract_manager (`exe::contract_manager_resolve_contract_offers`, two calls): copies the first item of the spare non-player record pool (`player_regen_fields::SPARE_NON_PLAYER_RECORDS`: id, nation and second nation) into the three outputs and removes it from the pool (PLAYER_REGEN::remove_spare_non_player_record `exe::player_regen_remove_spare_non_player_record` with the id read from the output); returns its eax.

Decides whether an English loan is allowed: refuses (0, with the message and the reason) between clubs of the same English division (0x1d), with five loans this season (0x1e), with more than one player on loan from another club in the squad (0x26) and outside the window (9); otherwise 1. \n `ENGLAND_RULES::can_loan_player(club, player, msg, reason)`, through the nation's rules in `TRANSFER_MANAGER::can_loan_player` (`transfer_manager_can_loan_player`). Without a contract (`game_get_contract_and_store`; or without the contract's club, `england_rules_club_of_contract`): allowed. The requesting club and the owner in the same English division (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_ENGLISH_PREMIER_DIVISION`): reason 0x1d. Five loans in the season (the table `[[0xde1f54] + 0x91c]`, `season_loans_entry`): 0x1e. More than one player from another club in the squad (the 50 slots, `club.squad()`, counted only with the player's id below `G_STAFF_COUNT`; `exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`): 0x26. Outside the window (`exe::transfer_rules_find_open_window`): 9, with the nation's adjective (`exe::nation_get_nationality_adjective`).

On 20 June, resets the season loan count of every club of this rule set's nation. \n `ENGLAND_RULES::daily_update(data)`, from the rules' daily pass: on 20 June (only the day of the year, `exe::date_date_549f70` with 1998), the season count (`season_loans_entry`) of each club (`G_CLUB_COUNT` in `G_CLUB_TABLE`) of these rules' nation (+0xa) goes back to zero.

Returns the loan period: after 19 June and with the player under 24, the base rule period; otherwise from next month to three months later. \n `ENGLAND_RULES::get_loan_period(club, a2, start_month, start_year, end_month, end_year, player)`, called from the loan period (`transfer_manager_get_loan_period`). After 19 June (only the day of the year, `exe::date_date_549f70` with 1998) and with the player under 24 (`age()`): the base rule period (`exe::transfer_rules_get_loan_period`). Otherwise it starts the following month (`exe::date_get_month`) and ends three months later.

Constructs the Turkey transfer rules (rule 24): one window, from 1 June to 31 January; `transfer_rules::FOREIGN_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 8 (base default 50) [inference: the foreign player limit]; `transfer_rules::NON_EU_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 8 (default 30). \n Ret 0x14, `TURKEY_RULES::TURKEY_RULES`; SEH frame only for the `new`, no destructor on the normal path: the base (`exe::new_transfer_rules`, through `construct_nation_rules`), vtable 0x97075c, 1 window from `TURKEY_TRANSFER_WINDOWS`; `transfer_rules::FOREIGN_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 8 (the base default is 50) [inference: the foreign player limit]; `transfer_rules::NON_EU_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 8 (the default is 30). Returns the object.

Builds the CM3_TEMP folder path in `[0xde279c]` and deletes its files matching the pattern, in groups of 100. \n `utils_clear_temp_folder(default)`: builds the temporary folder in `[0xde279c]` (the `CM3_TEMP` variable via `exe::utils_get_folder_for_key` + "\", if present, and the text of `[0xad9c64]`, copied with a limit by `exe::utils_copy_path_limited`) and deletes (`remove` `exe::crt_remove`) its files that match the pattern `default` (`exe::crt_makepath`, `exe::file_find_first`/`exe::file_find_next`/`exe::file_find_close`), in groups of 100 names (the search is closed before deleting and redone while the group fills up).
